## Specification

### Component: Chart (LineChart, AreaChart, BarChart, DonutChart, RadialChart, Sparkline)

Our own SVG chart engine: no chart library, only React. Calm and precise: dashed low-contrast grid, a crosshair that glides between points, a subtle draw-in. Colours are only ever CSS variables, so theme, dark mode and accent switch live without re-rendering.

#### Anatomy
```
<div class="ui-chart" style="--ui-chart-c0: var(--ui-series-1); …">   root, one var per series (or slice)
  .ui-chart-legend (top)            buttons .ui-chart-legend-item[aria-pressed] > .ui-chart-swatch
  .ui-chart-plot                    measured width, fixed height (placeholder on the server)
    .ui-chart-stage                 role="group", tabIndex 0, pointer + key handlers
      <svg role="img" aria-label>   grid · axes · marks · overlay (crosshair, dots, cursor)
      .ui-chart-tooltip             aria-hidden, absolutely positioned
      .ui-chart-center              donut / radial hole (HTML text)
      .ui-chart-sr[role=status]     polite live region (keyboard readout)
  .ui-chart-legend (bottom)
  table.ui-chart-sr                 every value, visually hidden
```
`Sparkline` is `.ui-sparkline > svg` with no stage.

#### Props
Common (`LineChart`, `AreaChart`, `BarChart`):
- `data` records, `index` (x key), `series: { key, label?, color? }[]` (`color`: `'series-1'`…`'series-6'` or any CSS colour; default cycles series-1…6).
- `height` (280), `valueFormat` (`'number' | 'currency' | 'percent' | 'compact' | Intl options | fn`; `'percent'` expects 0–100), `indexFormat`, `locale`.
- `xAxis` / `yAxis`: `boolean | options` (y: `format, ticks, width, domain: [min|'auto', max|'auto']`; x: `format`). Bottom and left axes, whatever the orientation.
- `grid`: `boolean | 'horizontal' | 'vertical' | 'both'` (true = horizontal; for horizontal bars true = vertical lines).
- `legend`: `'top' | 'bottom' | false` (default bottom when 2+ series). Items toggle series; the last visible series cannot be hidden.
- `tooltip`: `boolean | { labelFormat }`. `animate` (true). `aria-label`, `className`.
- `LineChart` / `AreaChart`: `curve: 'monotone' | 'linear' | 'step'` (monotone, no overshoot). `AreaChart`: `stacked`.
- `BarChart`: `stacked`, `orientation: 'vertical' | 'horizontal'`, `radius` (4).
- `DonutChart`: `data, index, valueKey, colors?, innerRadius` (0.62; 0 = pie), `padAngle` degrees (2), `cornerRadius` (4), `centerLabel`, `centerValue`, `valueFormat`, `legend` ('bottom'), `tooltip`, `animate`, `height` (240).
- `RadialChart`: `data, index, valueKey, max` (100), `variant: 'ring' | 'semicircle'`, `thickness`, `track` (true), `colors`, `centerLabel`, `centerValue`, `valueFormat`, `height` (240 / 160).
- `Sparkline`: `data` (numbers or records + `valueKey`), `variant: 'line' | 'area' | 'bar'`, `width` (fills parent), `height` (32), `color`, `trend` (success when last > first, destructive when below), `curve`, `dot` (true), `strokeWidth` (1.5).

#### Behaviour
- Width comes from a ResizeObserver on `.ui-chart-plot`; height is the prop. Nothing touches `window` during render. Before the first measure (and on the server) only the sized placeholder renders, so there is no layout shift and no hydration flash.
- Pointer / touch: the nearest index follows the pointer and snaps; touch scrubs horizontally (`touch-action: pan-y`) and keeps the readout until a tap elsewhere. Mouse leaving clears it.
- Keyboard (the stage is focusable): ←/→ (and ↑/↓) move the active index, Home/End jump, Esc clears. The readout text goes to the live region.
- Tooltip: label, then rows of swatch, series name and formatted value. It sits 14px beside the anchor, flips to the other side near the edge and is clamped inside the stage. It follows the pointer's y and snaps to the index's x. The first frame after appearing jumps; later frames glide (120ms).
- Bars: hovering a category dims the other categories' bars to 40% and shows a rounded `--ui-accent` slot behind it.
- Donut: hovering expands the slice 6px outward, dims the others, and the hole shows that slice's name and value. Radial: ring under the pointer thickens; hole shows its value.
- Data changes ease numbers over 450ms (requestAnimationFrame); a change in row count snaps. Hidden series leave the domain.
- Axis labels thin out so neighbours never overlap; y-axis width follows the widest tick label.

#### Visual rules
- Grid: 1px dashed `3 4`, `--ui-border` at 80%. Axis line `--ui-border-strong`. Axis text 12px `--ui-muted-foreground`, tabular numbers.
- Lines 2px, round caps and joins. Areas: gradient from the series colour at 34% (55% stacked) to 0% (12% stacked).
- Bars: rounded only on the far end (top, bottom for negatives, right/left for horizontal), radius 4, max width 48px per bar, 2px between grouped bars. Stacked: only the outermost segment of each sign is rounded.
- Active dots r=4.5 with a 2px `--ui-surface` ring. Crosshair 1px `--ui-border-strong`.
- Tooltip: `--ui-surface-raised`, 1px `--ui-border`, `--radius-md`, `--ui-shadow-md`, padding 8×10, 12px text, values 500 weight.
- Legend: 12px muted buttons, 28px high (36px on coarse pointers), hover only inside `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`, focus ring `0 0 0 3px` ring at 45%. Hidden series are struck through.
- Donut/radial centre value 24px/600, tracking −0.02em; label 12px muted. Track ring `--ui-surface-muted`.
- Focus on the stage: the standard 3px ring on `:focus-visible` only.

#### Motion
- Mount only, ≤ 700ms, `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`: lines draw in (stroke-dashoffset from `getTotalLength`, 600ms, 40ms stagger per series up to 100ms); areas fade up 8px (600ms); bars grow from the baseline (500ms, stagger ≤ 30ms and ≤ 200ms in total); donut and radial sweep (700ms).
- Crosshair, dots and bar slot glide 160ms; tooltip 120ms; opacity fades 150ms.
- `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` skips every entrance, tween and glide; the state still changes.

#### Accessibility
- The `svg` is `role="img"` with an `aria-label` (generated: kind, series, point count and range) unless `aria-label` is given. The focusable stage is `role="group"` labelled with the same summary and the key hint.
- A visually hidden `<table>` lists every value (row headers = index values); donut adds the share, radial the goal.
- Legend items are buttons with `aria-pressed`. The tooltip is `aria-hidden`; keyboard readouts go through `role="status"`.
- Colour is never the only identifier: legend and tooltip name every series. Axe passes in light and dark.

#### Acceptance checks
- Renders the right number of marks (one path per line/area series, one per non-zero bar, one per visible slice).
- Hover or touch shows the tooltip at the nearest index and it never leaves the chart, including at the right edge.
- ←/→ moves the active index, Esc clears it.
- Legend click hides a series and the marks follow; the last series cannot be hidden.
- Resizing the container redraws at the new width with aligned axes.
- No console errors, no layout shift on load, no window access in SSR.

## Files

Paths are relative to the folder the `@/` alias points to. The folder keeps the library's own layout, so the relative imports inside the files work unchanged.

### `ui/components/chart/area-chart.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import type { Curve } from './path';
import type { CartesianChartProps } from './types';
import { XYChart } from './xy-chart';

export interface AreaChartProps extends CartesianChartProps {
  curve?: Curve;
  /** Stack series on top of each other instead of overlaying them. */
  stacked?: boolean;
}

/** Line chart with a gradient fill that fades to transparent. */
export function AreaChart(props: AreaChartProps) {
  return <XYChart {...props} variant="area" />;
}
```

### `ui/components/chart/bar-chart.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { computeBars } from './bar-geometry';
import { CartesianStage } from './cartesian-stage';
import { ChartAxes } from './chart-axes';
import { ChartContainer } from './chart-container';
import { createAxisFormatter, createValueFormatter } from './format';
import { axisOptions, gridFlags, tooltipOptions } from './options';
import { toNumber } from './scale';
import { chartVars, defaultLabel, indexValue, resolveSeries, seriesVar, summarize } from './series';
import type { CartesianChartProps, ChartDatum, XAxisOptions, YAxisOptions } from './types';
import { useTweenedData } from './use-chart-motion';
import { useSeriesVisibility } from './use-series-visibility';

export interface BarChartProps extends CartesianChartProps {
  /** Stack the series in one bar per category instead of grouping them side by side. */
  stacked?: boolean;
  /** 'vertical' bars rise from the bottom; 'horizontal' bars run from the left. */
  orientation?: 'vertical' | 'horizontal';
  /** Corner radius of the rounded end, in px. */
  radius?: number;
}

/** Compare values across categories: grouped or stacked, vertical or horizontal, negatives allowed. */
export function BarChart({
  data,
  index,
  series,
  stacked = false,
  orientation = 'vertical',
  radius = 4,
  height = 280,
  valueFormat,
  indexFormat,
  locale,
  xAxis,
  yAxis,
  grid,
  legend,
  tooltip,
  animate = true,
  className,
  ...rest
}: BarChartProps) {
  const horizontal = orientation === 'horizontal';
  const all = useMemo(() => resolveSeries(series), [series]);
  const [hidden, toggle] = useSeriesVisibility();
  const visible = all.filter((s) => !hidden.has(s.key));
  const shown = useTweenedData(data, all.map((s) => s.key), animate);
  const fmtIndex = indexFormat ?? defaultLabel;
  const fmt = createValueFormatter(valueFormat, locale);
  const fmtAxis = createAxisFormatter(valueFormat, locale);
  const x = axisOptions<XAxisOptions>(xAxis);
  const y = axisOptions<YAxisOptions>(yAxis);
  const tip = tooltipOptions(tooltip);
  const labelOf = (row: ChartDatum, i: number) => fmtIndex(indexValue(row, index), i);
  const labels = data.map(labelOf);
  const kind = `${stacked ? 'Stacked bar' : 'Bar'} chart`;
  const name = rest['aria-label'] ?? summarize(kind, data.length, visible, labels[0], labels[labels.length - 1]);
  const legendPos = legend ?? (all.length > 1 ? 'bottom' : false);
  const g = gridFlags(grid);
  // Default grid runs along the value axis
  const gridH = grid === undefined || grid === true ? !horizontal : g.h;
  const gridV = grid === undefined || grid === true ? horizontal : g.v;

  return (
    <ChartContainer
      height={height}
      vars={chartVars(all.map((s) => s.color))}
      legend={legendPos}
      legendItems={all.map((s) => ({ key: s.key, label: s.label, color: seriesVar(s.index), visible: !hidden.has(s.key) }))}
      onLegendToggle={(key) => toggle(key, all.length)}
      className={className}
      table={{
        caption: name,
        columns: [index, ...all.map((s) => s.label)],
        rows: data.map((row, i) => [labels[i] ?? '', ...all.map((s) => { const v = toNumber(row[s.key]); return v == null ? '' : fmt(v); })]),
      }}
    >
      {(width) => (
        <BarPlot
          width={width}
          height={height}
          data={shown}
          rawData={data}
          index={index}
          labels={labels}
          visible={visible}
          stacked={stacked}
          horizontal={horizontal}
          radius={radius}
          showX={x.show}
          showY={y.show}
          yOptions={y.options}
          tooltipFormat={tip.options.labelFormat ?? fmtIndex}
          showTooltip={tip.show}
          fmt={fmt}
          formatTick={y.options.format ?? fmtAxis}
          gridH={gridH}
          gridV={gridV}
          animate={animate}
          label={name}
        />
      )}
    </ChartContainer>
  );
}

interface BarPlotProps {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  data: ChartDatum[];
  rawData: ChartDatum[];
  index: string;
  labels: string[];
  visible: ReturnType<typeof resolveSeries>;
  stacked: boolean;
  horizontal: boolean;
  radius: number;
  showX: boolean;
  showY: boolean;
  yOptions: YAxisOptions;
  tooltipFormat: (v: string | number, i: number) => string;
  showTooltip: boolean;
  fmt: (v: number) => string;
  formatTick: (v: number) => string;
  gridH: boolean;
  gridV: boolean;
  animate: boolean;
  label: string;
}

function BarPlot(p: BarPlotProps) {
  const lastIdx = useRef(0);
  const geo = useMemo(
    () =>
      computeBars({
        width: p.width,
        height: p.height,
        data: p.data,
        visible: p.visible,
        stacked: p.stacked,
        horizontal: p.horizontal,
        radius: p.radius,
        showX: p.showX,
        showY: p.showY,
        yOptions: p.yOptions,
        formatValue: p.formatTick,
        labels: p.labels,
      }),
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [p.width, p.height, p.data, p.visible, p.stacked, p.horizontal, p.radius, p.showX, p.showY, p.yOptions, p.formatTick, p.labels],
  );

  const axes = (
    <ChartAxes
      plot={geo.plot}
      hTicks={geo.hTicks}
      vTicks={geo.vTicks}
      gridH={p.gridH}
      gridV={p.gridV}
      leftLabels={p.showY}
      bottomLabels={p.showX}
      baseline={geo.baseline}
      zero={geo.zero}
    />
  );

  const readout = (i: number) => ({
    label: p.tooltipFormat(indexValue(p.rawData[i]!, p.index), i),
    rows: p.visible.map((s) => {
      const v = toNumber(p.rawData[i]![s.key]);
      return { color: seriesVar(s.index), name: s.label, value: v == null ? '—' : p.fmt(v) };
    }),
  });

  return (
    <CartesianStage
      width={p.width}
      height={p.height}
      ariaLabel={p.label}
      count={p.data.length}
      indexAt={geo.indexAt}
      marks={axes}
      readout={p.showTooltip && readout}
      anchorX={(i) => (p.horizontal ? geo.extent(i) : geo.centre(i))}
      anchorY={(i) => (p.horizontal ? geo.centre(i) : 36)}
      animate={p.animate}
      overlay={(active, glide) => {
        if (active != null) lastIdx.current = active;
        const i = Math.min(lastIdx.current, Math.max(p.data.length - 1, 0));
        const slot = geo.slot(i);
        const { left, right, top, bottom } = geo.plot;
        const on = active != null ? 'true' : 'false';
        return (
          <>
            <g aria-hidden="true">
              <g
                className="ui-chart-active"
                data-active={on}
                data-glide={glide}
                style={{ transform: p.horizontal ? `translateY(${slot.start}px)` : `translateX(${slot.start}px)` }}
              >
                <rect
                  className="ui-chart-cursor"
                  x={p.horizontal ? left : 0}
                  y={p.horizontal ? 0 : top}
                  width={p.horizontal ? right - left : slot.size}
                  height={p.horizontal ? slot.size : bottom - top}
                  rx={4}
                />
              </g>
              {geo.bars.map((b) => (
                <path
                  key={`${b.i}-${b.series.key}`}
                  d={b.d}
                  className="ui-chart-bar"
                  style={{ fill: seriesVar(b.series.index) }}
                  data-grow=""
                  data-axis={p.horizontal ? 'x' : 'y'}
                  data-origin={b.origin}
                  data-dim={active != null && active !== b.i ? 'true' : 'false'}
                />
              ))}
            </g>
          </>
        );
      }}
    />
  );
}
```

### `ui/components/chart/bar-geometry.ts`

```ts
import type { AxisTick } from './chart-axes';
import { labelIndices } from './chart-axes';
import { barPath } from './path';
import { bandScale, clamp, linearScale, niceScale, stackSeries, toNumber, type BandScale } from './scale';
import { labelWidth, type ResolvedSeries } from './series';
import type { ChartDatum, YAxisOptions } from './types';

export interface BarInput {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  data: ChartDatum[];
  visible: ResolvedSeries[];
  stacked: boolean;
  horizontal: boolean;
  radius: number;
  showX: boolean;
  showY: boolean;
  yOptions: YAxisOptions;
  formatValue: (v: number) => string;
  /** Category label for each row. */
  labels: string[];
}

export interface BarShape {
  series: ResolvedSeries;
  /** Category index. */
  i: number;
  d: string;
  /** CSS transform-origin for the grow-in (the baseline side). */
  origin: string;
}

export interface BarGeometry {
  plot: { left: number; right: number; top: number; bottom: number };
  band: BandScale;
  bars: BarShape[];
  hTicks: AxisTick[];
  vTicks: AxisTick[];
  zero: { pos: number; orient: 'h' | 'v' } | null;
  baseline: 'bottom' | 'left' | null;
  /** Slot of category `i` along the category axis: start and size. */
  slot: (i: number) => { start: number; size: number };
  /** Far end (value axis) of the longest bar in category `i`, as a pixel. */
  extent: (i: number) => number;
  /** Centre of category `i` along the category axis. */
  centre: (i: number) => number;
  indexAt: (x: number, y: number) => number;
}

const MAX_BAR = 48;
const GAP = 2;

export function computeBars(input: BarInput): BarGeometry {
  const { width, height, data, visible, stacked, horizontal, radius, showX, showY, yOptions, formatValue, labels } = input;
  const n = data.length;
  const K = visible.length;
  const stack = stacked ? stackSeries(data, visible.map((s) => s.key)) : null;

  const stackAt = (k: number, i: number) => stack![k]![i]!;
  let min = 0;
  let max = 0;
  visible.forEach((s, k) =>
    data.forEach((row, i) => {
      const lo = stack ? stackAt(k, i).lo : Math.min(toNumber(row[s.key]) ?? 0, 0);
      const hi = stack ? stackAt(k, i).hi : Math.max(toNumber(row[s.key]) ?? 0, 0);
      min = Math.min(min, lo);
      max = Math.max(max, hi);
    }),
  );

  const top = 10;
  const bottom = height - (showX ? 26 : 6);
  const catLabelW = labelWidth(labels);
  let left: number;
  let right: number;

  const [dLo, dHi] = yOptions.domain ?? ['auto', 'auto'];
  const plotW0 = width - 24;
  const count = yOptions.ticks ?? clamp(Math.round((horizontal ? plotW0 : height) / (horizontal ? 90 : 56)), 3, 6);
  const scale = niceScale(typeof dLo === 'number' ? dLo : min, typeof dHi === 'number' ? dHi : max, count);
  const domain: [number, number] = [typeof dLo === 'number' ? dLo : scale.min, typeof dHi === 'number' ? dHi : scale.max];
  const ticks = scale.ticks.filter((t) => t >= domain[0] - 1e-9 && t <= domain[1] + 1e-9);

  if (horizontal) {
    left = showY ? Math.min(catLabelW + 14, width * 0.4) : 6;
    right = width - 14;
  } else {
    left = showY ? (yOptions.width ?? labelWidth(ticks.map(formatValue)) + 12) : 6;
    right = width - 8;
  }

  const vs = horizontal ? linearScale(domain, [left, right]) : linearScale(domain, [bottom, top]);
  const band = horizontal ? bandScale(n, [top, bottom], { paddingInner: 0.3, paddingOuter: 0.15 }) : bandScale(n, [left, right], { paddingInner: 0.28, paddingOuter: 0.14 });
  const zeroPx = vs(clamp(0, domain[0], domain[1]));

  const bars: BarShape[] = [];
  data.forEach((row, i) => {
    // Which series ends each stack (positive and negative), so only that segment is rounded
    let lastPos = -1;
    let lastNeg = -1;
    visible.forEach((s, k) => {
      const v = toNumber(row[s.key]) ?? 0;
      if (v > 0) lastPos = k;
      else if (v < 0) lastNeg = k;
    });
    visible.forEach((s, k) => {
      const v = toNumber(row[s.key]) ?? 0;
      if (v === 0) return;
      const lo = stack ? stackAt(k, i).lo : Math.min(v, 0);
      const hi = stack ? stackAt(k, i).hi : Math.max(v, 0);
      const clampedLo = clamp(lo, domain[0], domain[1]);
      const clampedHi = clamp(hi, domain[0], domain[1]);
      const groupW = stacked ? Math.min(band.bandwidth, MAX_BAR + 8) : Math.min(band.bandwidth, MAX_BAR * K + GAP * (K - 1));
      const bw = stacked ? groupW : (groupW - GAP * (K - 1)) / K;
      const off = band(i) + (band.bandwidth - groupW) / 2 + (stacked ? 0 : k * (bw + GAP));
      const positive = v > 0;
      const rounded = stack ? (positive ? k === lastPos : k === lastNeg) : true;
      let d: string;
      let origin: string;
      if (horizontal) {
        const x0 = vs(clampedLo);
        const x1 = vs(clampedHi);
        d = barPath(x0, off, Math.max(x1 - x0, 0), bw, radius, rounded ? (positive ? 'right' : 'left') : 'none');
        origin = positive ? '0% 50%' : '100% 50%';
      } else {
        const y0 = vs(clampedHi);
        const y1 = vs(clampedLo);
        d = barPath(off, y0, bw, Math.max(y1 - y0, 0), radius, rounded ? (positive ? 'top' : 'bottom') : 'none');
        origin = positive ? '50% 100%' : '50% 0%';
      }
      bars.push({ series: s, i, d, origin });
    });
  });

  const cats: AxisTick[] = labelIndices(n, horizontal ? bottom - top : right - left, horizontal ? 4 : catLabelW).map((i) => ({
    pos: band(i) + band.bandwidth / 2,
    label: labels[i] ?? '',
  }));
  const valueTicks: AxisTick[] = ticks.map((t) => ({ pos: vs(t), label: formatValue(t) }));
  const crossesZero = domain[0] < 0 && domain[1] > 0;
  const catAxis = (showX && !horizontal) || (showY && horizontal);

  return {
    plot: { left, right, top, bottom },
    band,
    bars,
    hTicks: horizontal ? (catAxis ? cats : []) : valueTicks,
    vTicks: horizontal ? valueTicks : catAxis ? cats : [],
    zero: crossesZero ? { pos: zeroPx, orient: horizontal ? 'v' : 'h' } : null,
    baseline: crossesZero ? null : horizontal ? 'left' : 'bottom',
    slot: (i) => ({ start: band(i) - (band.step - band.bandwidth) / 2, size: band.step }),
    extent: (i) => {
      let best = horizontal ? left : bottom;
      visible.forEach((s, k) => {
        const hi = stack ? stackAt(k, i).hi : Math.max(toNumber(data[i]![s.key]) ?? 0, 0);
        const px = vs(clamp(hi, domain[0], domain[1]));
        best = horizontal ? Math.max(best, px) : Math.min(best, px);
      });
      return best;
    },
    centre: (i) => band(i) + band.bandwidth / 2,
    indexAt: (x, y) => band.indexAt(horizontal ? y : x),
  };
}
```

### `ui/components/chart/cartesian-stage.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { ChartTooltip, TooltipContent, type TooltipRow } from './chart-tooltip';
import { useEntrance } from './use-chart-motion';
import { useIndexInteraction } from './use-index-interaction';

export interface StageReadout {
  label: string;
  rows: TooltipRow[];
}

export interface CartesianStageProps {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  ariaLabel: string;
  count: number;
  /** Nearest index for a pointer position inside the stage. */
  indexAt: (x: number, y: number) => number;
  /** Static marks: grid, axes, series. Memoise this node so pointer moves do not rebuild it. */
  marks: ReactNode;
  /** Crosshair, dots and bar highlights; rendered inside the svg after the marks. */
  overlay?: (active: number | null, glide: boolean) => ReactNode;
  /** Tooltip content for an index; false hides the tooltip. */
  readout: false | ((index: number) => StageReadout);
  /** Pixel x the tooltip is anchored to for an index. */
  anchorX: (index: number) => number;
  /** Tooltip y for keyboard and touch (the pointer drives it otherwise). */
  anchorY?: (index: number) => number;
  animate: boolean;
  /** Called with the active index (null when cleared). */
  onActiveChange?: (index: number | null) => void;
  svgClassName?: string;
}

/**
 * The interactive surface shared by line, area and bar charts: pointer and
 * touch scrubbing, arrow-key navigation, tooltip and a polite live region.
 */
export function CartesianStage({
  width,
  height,
  ariaLabel,
  count,
  indexAt,
  marks,
  overlay,
  readout,
  anchorX,
  anchorY,
  animate,
  onActiveChange,
  svgClassName,
}: CartesianStageProps) {
  const { active, props } = useIndexInteraction(count, indexAt);
  const { ref, ...handlers } = props;
  useEntrance(ref, animate);

  const glide = useRef(false);
  const idx = active.index;
  useEffect(() => {
    glide.current = idx != null;
    onActiveChange?.(idx);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [idx]);

  const info = idx != null && readout ? readout(idx) : null;
  const last = useRef<StageReadout | null>(null);
  if (info) last.current = info;
  const lastX = useRef(0);
  if (idx != null) lastX.current = anchorX(idx);
  const y = active.source === 'pointer' ? active.y : idx != null && anchorY ? anchorY(idx) : 36;

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      className="ui-chart-stage"
      role="group"
      aria-label={`${ariaLabel} Use the arrow keys to move between values.`}
      style={{ width, height }}
      data-active={idx != null ? 'true' : 'false'}
      {...handlers}
    >
      <svg width={width} height={height} viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`} role="img" aria-label={ariaLabel} className={svgClassName}>
        {marks}
        {overlay ? overlay(idx, glide.current) : null}
      </svg>
      {readout ? (
        <ChartTooltip visible={!!info} x={idx != null ? anchorX(idx) : lastX.current} y={y} width={width} height={height}>
          {last.current ? <TooltipContent label={last.current.label} rows={last.current.rows} /> : null}
        </ChartTooltip>
      ) : null}
      <div className="ui-chart-sr" aria-live="polite" role="status">
        {active.source === 'keyboard' && info ? `${info.label}: ${info.rows.map((r) => `${r.name} ${r.value}`).join(', ')}` : ''}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `ui/components/chart/chart-axes.tsx`

```tsx
export interface AxisTick {
  pos: number;
  label: string;
}

export interface ChartAxesProps {
  plot: { left: number; right: number; top: number; bottom: number };
  /** Horizontal lines (y positions) and their labels, shown on the left. */
  hTicks: AxisTick[];
  /** Vertical lines (x positions) and their labels, shown at the bottom. */
  vTicks: AxisTick[];
  gridH: boolean;
  gridV: boolean;
  leftLabels: boolean;
  bottomLabels: boolean;
  /** Solid axis line along the bottom or the left edge of the plot. */
  baseline?: 'bottom' | 'left' | null;
  /** Solid zero line (negative values). */
  zero?: { pos: number; orient: 'h' | 'v' } | null;
}

/** Grid, axis lines and tick labels. Classes carry the colours; nothing here reads a colour. */
export function ChartAxes({ plot, hTicks, vTicks, gridH, gridV, leftLabels, bottomLabels, baseline = 'bottom', zero }: ChartAxesProps) {
  const { left, right, top, bottom } = plot;
  return (
    <g aria-hidden="true">
      {gridH &&
        hTicks.map((t, i) => <line key={`h${i}`} className="ui-chart-grid" x1={left} x2={right} y1={t.pos} y2={t.pos} />)}
      {gridV &&
        vTicks.map((t, i) => <line key={`v${i}`} className="ui-chart-grid" x1={t.pos} x2={t.pos} y1={top} y2={bottom} />)}
      {baseline === 'bottom' && <line className="ui-chart-axis-line" x1={left} x2={right} y1={bottom} y2={bottom} />}
      {baseline === 'left' && <line className="ui-chart-axis-line" x1={left} x2={left} y1={top} y2={bottom} />}
      {zero && zero.orient === 'h' && <line className="ui-chart-axis-line" x1={left} x2={right} y1={zero.pos} y2={zero.pos} />}
      {zero && zero.orient === 'v' && <line className="ui-chart-axis-line" x1={zero.pos} x2={zero.pos} y1={top} y2={bottom} />}
      {leftLabels &&
        hTicks.map((t, i) => (
          <text key={`l${i}`} className="ui-chart-axis" x={left - 8} y={t.pos} dy="0.32em" textAnchor="end">
            {t.label}
          </text>
        ))}
      {bottomLabels &&
        vTicks.map((t, i) => (
          <text key={`b${i}`} className="ui-chart-axis" x={t.pos} y={bottom + 18} textAnchor="middle">
            {t.label}
          </text>
        ))}
    </g>
  );
}

/** Indices to label so neighbouring labels do not overlap (always includes the first). */
export function labelIndices(count: number, plotWidth: number, labelW: number): number[] {
  if (count === 0) return [];
  const fit = Math.max(1, Math.floor(plotWidth / (labelW + 12)));
  const stride = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(count / fit));
  const out: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < count; i += stride) out.push(i);
  return out;
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import type { CSSProperties, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { ChartLegend, type LegendItem } from './chart-legend';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import type { LegendPosition } from './types';
import { useChartSize } from './use-chart-size';

export interface ChartTable {
  caption: string;
  columns: string[];
  rows: string[][];
}

export interface ChartContainerProps {
  /** Plot height in px; reserved on the server and before the first measure. */
  height: number;
  /** `--ui-chart-cN` custom properties (see chartVars). */
  vars: CSSProperties;
  legend: LegendPosition;
  legendItems: LegendItem[];
  onLegendToggle: (key: string) => void;
  table: ChartTable;
  className?: string;
  /** Rendered once the width is known (never on the server). */
  children: (width: number) => ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Shared frame for every chart: measures the width, reserves the height,
 * lays out the legend and carries the visually hidden data table.
 */
export function ChartContainer({ height, vars, legend, legendItems, onLegendToggle, table, className, children }: ChartContainerProps) {
  const { ref, width } = useChartSize<HTMLDivElement>();
  const legendEl = legend ? <ChartLegend items={legendItems} onToggle={onLegendToggle} /> : null;
  return (
    <div className={cn('ui-chart', className)} style={vars} data-legend={legend || undefined}>
      {legend === 'top' ? legendEl : null}
      <div ref={ref} className="ui-chart-plot" style={{ height }}>
        {width > 0 ? children(width) : null}
      </div>
      {legend === 'bottom' ? legendEl : null}
      <table className="ui-chart-sr">
        <caption>{table.caption}</caption>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            {table.columns.map((c, i) => (
              <th key={i} scope="col">
                {c}
              </th>
            ))}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {table.rows.map((row, i) => (
            <tr key={i}>
              {row.map((cell, j) =>
                j === 0 ? (
                  <th key={j} scope="row">
                    {cell}
                  </th>
                ) : (
                  <td key={j}>{cell}</td>
                ),
              )}
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
export interface LegendItem {

  label: string;

/** Legend whose items are toggle buttons: pressing one hides or shows that series. */
export function ChartLegend({
  items,

}: {
  items: LegendItem[];
  onToggle: (key: string) => void;
  label?: string;
}) {

      {items.map((item) => (
        <button
          key={item.key}
          type="button"
          className="ui-chart-legend-item"
          aria-pressed={item.visible}

          <span className="ui-chart-swatch" style={{ background: item.color }} aria-hidden="true" />
          {item.label}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';

export interface TooltipRow {
  color: string;
  name: string;
  value: string;
}

export function TooltipContent({ label, rows }: { label?: string; rows: TooltipRow[] }) {
  return (
    <>
      {label ? <div className="ui-chart-tooltip-label">{label}</div> : null}
      {rows.map((r, i) => (
        <div key={`${r.name}-${i}`} className="ui-chart-tooltip-row">
          <span className="ui-chart-swatch" style={{ background: r.color }} aria-hidden="true" />
          <span className="ui-chart-tooltip-name">{r.name}</span>
          <span className="ui-chart-tooltip-value">{r.value}</span>
        </div>
      ))}
    </>
  );
}

export interface ChartTooltipProps {
  visible: boolean;
  /** Anchor in stage px: the tooltip sits beside it. */
  x: number;
  y: number;
  /** Stage size: the tooltip never leaves it. */
  width: number;
  height: number;
  /** Gap between the anchor and the tooltip. */
  offset?: number;
  children: ReactNode;
}

/**
 * Floating readout that glides between anchors, flips to the other side of the
 * anchor near the edge and is clamped inside the stage. Position is written
 * straight to the element so it follows the pointer without extra renders.
 */
export function ChartTooltip({ visible, x, y, width, height, offset = 14, children }: ChartTooltipProps) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const wasVisible = useRef(false);

  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const w = el.offsetWidth;
    const h = el.offsetHeight;
    let left = x + offset;
    if (left + w > width) left = x - offset - w;
    left = Math.min(Math.max(left, 0), Math.max(width - w, 0));
    const top = Math.min(Math.max(y - h / 2, 0), Math.max(height - h, 0));
    // First frame after appearing: jump, do not glide in from the previous spot
    if (!wasVisible.current) el.style.transition = 'none';
    el.style.transform = `translate(${Math.round(left)}px, ${Math.round(top)}px)`;
    if (!wasVisible.current) {
      void el.offsetWidth;
      el.style.transition = '';
    }
    wasVisible.current = visible;
  });

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="ui-chart-tooltip" data-visible={visible ? 'true' : 'false'} aria-hidden="true">
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `ui/components/chart/donut-chart.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { useMemo, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { ChartContainer } from './chart-container';
import { ChartTooltip, TooltipContent } from './chart-tooltip';
import { createValueFormatter } from './format';
import { arcPath, polar } from './path';
import { toNumber } from './scale';
import { chartVars, resolveColor, seriesVar } from './series';
import type { ChartDatum, LegendPosition, SeriesColor, ValueFormat } from './types';
import { useSweep, useTweenedData } from './use-chart-motion';
import { useIndexInteraction } from './use-index-interaction';
import { useSeriesVisibility } from './use-series-visibility';

export interface DonutChartProps {
  data: ChartDatum[];
  /** Key of the slice name in each record. */
  index: string;
  /** Key of the slice value in each record. */
  valueKey: string;
  /** One colour per slice (series-1 ... series-6 or any CSS colour). Defaults to the theme series colours in order. */
  colors?: SeriesColor[];
  height?: number;
  /** Hole size as a fraction of the outer radius. 0 draws a pie. */
  innerRadius?: number;
  /** Gap between slices in degrees. */
  padAngle?: number;
  cornerRadius?: number;
  /** Small caption in the hole. Defaults to the hovered slice name, or "Total". */
  centerLabel?: ReactNode;
  /** Big value in the hole. Defaults to the hovered slice value, or the total. */
  centerValue?: ReactNode;
  valueFormat?: ValueFormat;
  locale?: string;
  legend?: LegendPosition;
  tooltip?: boolean;
  animate?: boolean;
  'aria-label'?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/** Parts of a whole. A donut by default; `innerRadius={0}` makes it a pie. */
export function DonutChart({
  data,
  index,
  valueKey,
  colors,
  height = 240,
  innerRadius = 0.62,
  padAngle = 2,
  cornerRadius = 4,
  centerLabel,
  centerValue,
  valueFormat,
  locale,
  legend = 'bottom',
  tooltip = true,
  animate = true,
  className,
  ...rest
}: DonutChartProps) {
  const [hidden, toggle] = useSeriesVisibility();
  const shown = useTweenedData(data, [valueKey], animate);
  const fmt = createValueFormatter(valueFormat, locale);
  const percent = createValueFormatter({ style: 'percent', maximumFractionDigits: 1 }, locale);
  const names = data.map((row) => String(row[index] ?? ''));
  const cols = data.map((_, i) => resolveColor(colors?.[i], i));
  const total = (rows: ChartDatum[]) => rows.reduce((t, row, i) => t + (hidden.has(names[i]!) ? 0 : Math.max(toNumber(row[valueKey]) ?? 0, 0)), 0);
  const sum = total(data);
  const name =
    rest['aria-label'] ??
    `${innerRadius > 0 ? 'Donut' : 'Pie'} chart: ${data.map((row, i) => `${names[i]} ${fmt(toNumber(row[valueKey]) ?? 0)}`).join(', ')}.`;

  return (
    <ChartContainer
      height={height}
      vars={chartVars(cols)}
      legend={legend}
      legendItems={data.map((_, i) => ({ key: names[i]!, label: names[i]!, color: seriesVar(i), visible: !hidden.has(names[i]!) }))}
      onLegendToggle={(key) => toggle(key, data.length)}
      className={className}
      table={{
        caption: name,
        columns: [index, valueKey, 'Share'],
        rows: data.map((row, i) => {
          const v = toNumber(row[valueKey]) ?? 0;
          return [names[i]!, fmt(v), sum > 0 ? percent(v / sum) : ''];
        }),
      }}
    >
      {(width) => (
        <DonutPlot
          width={width}
          height={height}
          rows={shown}
          names={names}
          hidden={hidden}
          valueKey={valueKey}
          innerRadius={innerRadius}
          padAngle={padAngle}
          cornerRadius={cornerRadius}
          centerLabel={centerLabel}
          centerValue={centerValue}
          fmt={fmt}
          percent={percent}
          showTooltip={tooltip}
          animate={animate}
          label={name}
        />
      )}
    </ChartContainer>
  );
}

interface Slice {
  /** Index into the original data. */
  i: number;
  value: number;
  start: number;
  end: number;
}

interface DonutPlotProps {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  rows: ChartDatum[];
  names: string[];
  hidden: ReadonlySet<string>;
  valueKey: string;
  innerRadius: number;
  padAngle: number;
  cornerRadius: number;
  centerLabel?: ReactNode;
  centerValue?: ReactNode;
  fmt: (v: number) => string;
  percent: (v: number) => string;
  showTooltip: boolean;
  animate: boolean;
  label: string;
}

const EXPAND = 6;

function DonutPlot(p: DonutPlotProps) {
  const sweep = useSweep(p.animate);
  const cx = p.width / 2;
  const cy = p.height / 2;
  const outer = Math.max(Math.min(p.width, p.height) / 2 - EXPAND - 2, 8);
  const inner = outer * Math.min(Math.max(p.innerRadius, 0), 0.95);

  const { slices, sum } = useMemo(() => {
    const vals = p.rows.map((row, i) => (p.hidden.has(p.names[i]!) ? 0 : Math.max(toNumber(row[p.valueKey]) ?? 0, 0)));
    const sum = vals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
    let acc = 0;
    const slices: Slice[] = [];
    vals.forEach((v, i) => {
      if (v <= 0 || sum <= 0) return;
      const span = (v / sum) * Math.PI * 2;
      slices.push({ i, value: v, start: acc, end: acc + span });
      acc += span;
    });
    return { slices, sum };
  }, [p.rows, p.names, p.hidden, p.valueKey]);

  const { active, props } = useIndexInteraction(slices.length, (x, y) => {
    const dist = Math.hypot(x - cx, y - cy);
    if (dist > outer + EXPAND + 6 || dist < inner * 0.85) return -1;
    let a = Math.atan2(x - cx, -(y - cy));
    if (a < 0) a += Math.PI * 2;
    const hit = slices.findIndex((s) => a >= s.start && a < s.end);
    return hit;
  });
  const { ref, ...handlers } = props;
  const k = active.index != null && active.index >= 0 && active.index < slices.length ? active.index : null;
  const current = k != null ? slices[k] : null;
  const mid = current ? (current.start + current.end) / 2 : 0;
  const anchor = current ? polar(cx, cy, (inner + outer) / 2, mid) : { x: cx, y: cy };
  const tipX = active.source === 'pointer' ? active.x : anchor.x;
  const tipY = active.source === 'pointer' ? active.y : anchor.y;
  const limit = sweep * Math.PI * 2;
  const pad = (p.padAngle * Math.PI) / 180;
  const holeW = Math.max(inner * 1.7, 0);
  const showCenter = inner > 24;

  const label = current ? p.names[current.i] : (p.centerLabel ?? 'Total');
  const value = current ? p.fmt(current.value) : (p.centerValue ?? p.fmt(sum));

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      className="ui-chart-stage"
      role="group"
      aria-label={`${p.label} Use the arrow keys to move between slices.`}
      style={{ width: p.width, height: p.height }}
      data-active={current ? 'true' : 'false'}
      {...handlers}
    >
      <svg width={p.width} height={p.height} viewBox={`0 0 ${p.width} ${p.height}`} role="img" aria-label={p.label}>
        {slices.length === 0 && inner > 0 && (
          <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={(inner + outer) / 2} fill="none" strokeWidth={outer - inner} className="ui-chart-track" />
        )}
        {slices.map((s, n) => {
          if (s.start >= limit) return null;
          const dx = Math.sin((s.start + s.end) / 2) * EXPAND;
          const dy = -Math.cos((s.start + s.end) / 2) * EXPAND;
          const on = k === n;
          return (
            <path
              key={p.names[s.i]}
              className="ui-chart-slice"
              d={arcPath({ cx, cy, inner, outer, start: s.start, end: Math.min(s.end, limit), padAngle: pad, cornerRadius: p.cornerRadius })}
              style={{ fill: seriesVar(s.i), transform: on ? `translate(${dx}px, ${dy}px)` : 'translate(0px, 0px)' }}
              data-dim={k != null && !on ? 'true' : 'false'}
            />
          );
        })}
      </svg>
      {showCenter && (
        <div className="ui-chart-center" style={{ width: holeW }} aria-hidden="true">
          <div className="ui-chart-center-label">{label}</div>
          <div className="ui-chart-center-value">{value}</div>
        </div>
      )}
      {p.showTooltip && (
        <ChartTooltip visible={!!current} x={tipX} y={tipY} width={p.width} height={p.height}>
          {current && (
            <TooltipContent
              rows={[{ color: seriesVar(current.i), name: p.names[current.i]!, value: `${p.fmt(current.value)} · ${p.percent(current.value / sum)}` }]}
            />
          )}
        </ChartTooltip>
      )}
      <div className="ui-chart-sr" role="status" aria-live="polite">
        {active.source === 'keyboard' && current ? `${p.names[current.i]}: ${p.fmt(current.value)}, ${p.percent(current.value / sum)}` : ''}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `ui/components/chart/format.ts`

```ts
/** Number formatting through Intl, cached (constructing Intl.NumberFormat is slow). */

export type ValueFormatOptions = Intl.NumberFormatOptions & { locale?: string };
export type ValueFormat = 'number' | 'currency' | 'percent' | 'compact' | ValueFormatOptions | ((value: number) => string);

const cache = new Map<string, Intl.NumberFormat>();

function intl(options: Intl.NumberFormatOptions, locale?: string): Intl.NumberFormat {
  const key = `${locale ?? ''}|${JSON.stringify(options)}`;
  let f = cache.get(key);
  if (!f) {
    f = new Intl.NumberFormat(locale, options);
    cache.set(key, f);
  }
  return f;
}

const PRESETS: Record<string, Intl.NumberFormatOptions> = {
  number: { maximumFractionDigits: 2 },
  currency: { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD', maximumFractionDigits: 0 },
  compact: { notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: 1 },
};

/**
 * Full-precision formatter for tooltips and labels.
 * `'percent'` expects values already on a 0-100 scale (42 gives "42%"); pass
 * `{ style: 'percent' }` for fractions (0.42 gives "42%").
 */
export function createValueFormatter(format: ValueFormat = 'number', locale?: string): (value: number) => string {
  if (typeof format === 'function') return format;
  if (format === 'percent') {
    const f = intl({ maximumFractionDigits: 1 }, locale);
    return (v) => `${f.format(v)}%`;
  }
  if (typeof format === 'string') {
    const f = intl(PRESETS[format] ?? PRESETS.number!, locale);
    return (v) => f.format(v);
  }
  const { locale: own, ...options } = format;
  const f = intl(options, own ?? locale);
  return (v) => f.format(v);
}

/** Short formatter for axis ticks: compact notation unless the format says otherwise. */
export function createAxisFormatter(format: ValueFormat = 'number', locale?: string): (value: number) => string {
  if (typeof format === 'function') return format;
  if (format === 'percent') return createValueFormatter('percent', locale);
  if (format === 'number' || format === 'compact') return createValueFormatter('compact', locale);
  if (format === 'currency') {
    return createValueFormatter({ ...PRESETS.currency, notation: 'compact', minimumFractionDigits: 0, maximumFractionDigits: 1 }, locale);
  }
  if (format.style === 'percent' || format.notation) return createValueFormatter(format, locale);
  return createValueFormatter({ ...format, notation: 'compact', maximumFractionDigits: format.maximumFractionDigits ?? 1 }, locale);
}
```

```ts
import type { GridOption, TooltipOptions } from './types';

export function gridFlags(grid: GridOption | undefined): { h: boolean; v: boolean } {
  if (grid === undefined || grid === true) return { h: true, v: false };
  if (grid === false) return { h: false, v: false };
  return { h: grid === 'horizontal' || grid === 'both', v: grid === 'vertical' || grid === 'both' };
}

const EMPTY = {};

export function axisOptions<T extends object>(value: boolean | T | undefined): { show: boolean; options: Partial<T> } {
  if (value === undefined || value === true) return { show: true, options: EMPTY as Partial<T> };
  if (value === false) return { show: false, options: EMPTY as Partial<T> };
  return { show: true, options: value };
}

export function tooltipOptions(value: boolean | TooltipOptions | undefined): { show: boolean; options: TooltipOptions } {
  if (value === undefined || value === true) return { show: true, options: EMPTY };
  if (value === false) return { show: false, options: EMPTY };
  return { show: true, options: value };
}
```

### `ui/components/chart/path.ts`

```ts
/** SVG path builders: curves, areas, bars and arcs. Pure functions, no DOM. */

export interface Point {
  x: number;
  y: number;
}
export type Curve = 'monotone' | 'linear' | 'step';

const r = (n: number) => Math.round(n * 100) / 100;
const pt = (x: number, y: number) => `${r(x)} ${r(y)}`;

/**
 * Fritsch-Carlson tangents: the curve never overshoots a data value, so a flat
 * run stays flat and a peak is never drawn higher than the data.
 */
function tangents(p: Point[]): number[] {
  const n = p.length;
  const d: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
    const p0 = p[i]!;
    const p1 = p[i + 1]!;
    const dx = p1.x - p0.x;
    d.push(dx === 0 ? 0 : (p1.y - p0.y) / dx);
  }
  const m: number[] = new Array(n);
  const dd = (i: number) => d[i]!;
  const mm = (i: number) => m[i]!;
  m[0] = d[0] ?? 0;
  m[n - 1] = d[n - 2] ?? 0;
  for (let i = 1; i < n - 1; i++) m[i] = dd(i - 1) * dd(i) <= 0 ? 0 : (dd(i - 1) + dd(i)) / 2;
  for (let i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
    if (dd(i) === 0) {
      m[i] = 0;
      m[i + 1] = 0;
      continue;
    }
    const a = mm(i) / dd(i);
    const b = mm(i + 1) / dd(i);
    const s = a * a + b * b;
    if (s > 9) {
      const t = 3 / Math.sqrt(s);
      m[i] = t * a * dd(i);
      m[i + 1] = t * b * dd(i);
    }
  }
  return m;
}

/** Bezier control points for each segment of a monotone curve. */
export function monotoneControls(p: Point[]): { c1: Point; c2: Point }[] {
  if (p.length < 2) return [];
  const m = tangents(p);
  return p.slice(0, -1).map((a, i) => {
    const b = p[i + 1]!;
    const h = b.x - a.x;
    return {
      c1: { x: a.x + h / 3, y: a.y + (m[i]! * h) / 3 },
      c2: { x: b.x - h / 3, y: b.y - (m[i + 1]! * h) / 3 },
    };
  });
}

/** Segment commands (everything after the initial move) for one run of points. */
function segments(p: Point[], curve: Curve): string {
  if (p.length < 2) return '';
  if (curve === 'linear') return p.slice(1).map((q) => `L${pt(q.x, q.y)}`).join('');
  if (curve === 'step') {
    let s = '';
    for (let i = 1; i < p.length; i++) {
      const cur = p[i]!;
      s += `L${pt(cur.x, p[i - 1]!.y)}L${pt(cur.x, cur.y)}`;
    }
    return s;
  }
  return monotoneControls(p)
    .map((c, i) => `C${pt(c.c1.x, c.c1.y)} ${pt(c.c2.x, c.c2.y)} ${pt(p[i + 1]!.x, p[i + 1]!.y)}`)
    .join('');
}

/** Split into runs of consecutive defined points (gaps = null). */
function runs(points: (Point | null)[]): Point[][] {
  const out: Point[][] = [];
  let cur: Point[] = [];
  for (const q of points) {
    if (q) cur.push(q);
    else if (cur.length) {
      out.push(cur);
      cur = [];
    }
  }
  if (cur.length) out.push(cur);
  return out;
}

export function linePath(points: (Point | null)[], curve: Curve = 'monotone'): string {
  return runs(points)
    .map((run) => `M${pt(run[0]!.x, run[0]!.y)}${segments(run, curve)}`)
    .join('');
}

/**
 * Closed area between `top` and either a flat baseline (number) or a lower line
 * (stacked areas). The lower line is drawn backwards with the same curve.
 */
export function areaPath(top: Point[], bottom: number | Point[], curve: Curve = 'monotone'): string {
  if (top.length === 0) return '';
  const low = typeof bottom === 'number' ? top.map((q) => ({ x: q.x, y: bottom })) : bottom;
  const back = [...low].reverse();
  const first = top[0]!;
  const last = back[0] ?? first;
  const head = `M${pt(first.x, first.y)}${segments(top, curve)}`;
  return `${head}L${pt(last.x, last.y)}${segments(back, curve)}Z`;
}

export type BarEdge = 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right' | 'none';

/** A bar with only the far end rounded (top for rising bars, bottom for negative ones...). */
export function barPath(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number, radius: number, edge: BarEdge): string {
  const rad = Math.max(0, Math.min(radius, w / 2, h / 2));
  const x1 = x + w;
  const y1 = y + h;
  if (edge === 'none' || rad === 0) return `M${pt(x, y)}H${r(x1)}V${r(y1)}H${r(x)}Z`;
  const a = (dx: number, dy: number) => `A${r(rad)} ${r(rad)} 0 0 1 ${pt(dx, dy)}`;
  switch (edge) {
    case 'top':
      return `M${pt(x, y1)}V${r(y + rad)}${a(x + rad, y)}H${r(x1 - rad)}${a(x1, y + rad)}V${r(y1)}Z`;
    case 'bottom':
      return `M${pt(x, y)}H${r(x1)}V${r(y1 - rad)}${a(x1 - rad, y1)}H${r(x + rad)}${a(x, y1 - rad)}Z`;
    case 'right':
      return `M${pt(x, y)}H${r(x1 - rad)}${a(x1, y + rad)}V${r(y1 - rad)}${a(x1 - rad, y1)}H${r(x)}Z`;
    default:
      return `M${pt(x1, y)}H${r(x + rad)}${a(x, y + rad)}V${r(y1 - rad)}${a(x + rad, y1)}H${r(x1)}Z`;
  }
}

/** Polar to cartesian. Angles in radians, 0 at 12 o'clock, increasing clockwise. */
export function polar(cx: number, cy: number, radius: number, angle: number): Point {
  return { x: cx + radius * Math.sin(angle), y: cy - radius * Math.cos(angle) };
}

export interface ArcOptions {
  cx: number;
  cy: number;
  inner: number;
  outer: number;
  start: number;
  end: number;
  /** Gap between neighbouring slices, in radians (split between both edges). */
  padAngle?: number;
  cornerRadius?: number;
}

/** Closed donut/pie slice with an angular gap and rounded corners. */
export function arcPath({ cx, cy, inner, outer, start, end, padAngle = 0, cornerRadius = 0 }: ArcOptions): string {
  const full = Math.PI * 2;
  if (end - start >= full - 1e-4) {
    const o = (a: number) => pt(cx + outer * Math.sin(a), cy - outer * Math.cos(a));
    const ring = `M${o(0)}A${r(outer)} ${r(outer)} 0 1 1 ${o(Math.PI)}A${r(outer)} ${r(outer)} 0 1 1 ${o(0)}Z`;
    if (inner <= 0.5) return ring;
    const i = (a: number) => pt(cx + inner * Math.sin(a), cy - inner * Math.cos(a));
    return `${ring}M${i(0)}A${r(inner)} ${r(inner)} 0 1 0 ${i(Math.PI)}A${r(inner)} ${r(inner)} 0 1 0 ${i(0)}Z`;
  }
  const pad = Math.min(padAngle / 2, (end - start) / 4);
  const a0 = start + pad;
  const a1 = end - pad;
  const span = a1 - a0;
  const pie = inner <= 0.5;
  // Shrink the corner until the fillets fit inside the slice
  let rc = Math.max(0, Math.min(cornerRadius, (outer - (pie ? 0 : inner)) / 2 - 0.01));
  for (let i = 0; i < 12 && rc > 0.2; i++) {
    const dOuter = Math.asin(Math.min(1, rc / (outer - rc)));
    const dInner = pie ? 0 : Math.asin(Math.min(1, rc / (inner + rc)));
    if (2 * dOuter <= span && 2 * dInner <= span) break;
    rc *= 0.8;
  }
  const P = (rad: number, a: number) => polar(cx, cy, rad, a);
  const s = (p: Point) => pt(p.x, p.y);
  const R = r(rc);

  if (rc < 0.2) {
    const large = span > Math.PI ? 1 : 0;
    const o0 = P(outer, a0);
    const o1 = P(outer, a1);
    if (pie) return `M${pt(cx, cy)}L${s(o0)}A${r(outer)} ${r(outer)} 0 ${large} 1 ${s(o1)}Z`;
    const i0 = P(inner, a0);
    const i1 = P(inner, a1);
    return `M${s(i0)}L${s(o0)}A${r(outer)} ${r(outer)} 0 ${large} 1 ${s(o1)}L${s(i1)}A${r(inner)} ${r(inner)} 0 ${large} 0 ${s(i0)}Z`;
  }

  // Fillet circles sit rc inside the outer circle and rc from each radial edge
  const dO = Math.asin(rc / (outer - rc));
  const lineO = Math.sqrt((outer - rc) ** 2 - rc ** 2);
  const o0Line = P(lineO, a0);
  const o0Arc = P(outer, a0 + dO);
  const o1Arc = P(outer, a1 - dO);
  const o1Line = P(lineO, a1);
  const outerLarge = span - 2 * dO > Math.PI ? 1 : 0;
  if (pie) {
    return `M${pt(cx, cy)}L${s(o0Line)}A${R} ${R} 0 0 1 ${s(o0Arc)}A${r(outer)} ${r(outer)} 0 ${outerLarge} 1 ${s(o1Arc)}A${R} ${R} 0 0 1 ${s(o1Line)}Z`;
  }
  const dI = Math.asin(rc / (inner + rc));
  const lineI = Math.sqrt((inner + rc) ** 2 - rc ** 2);
  const i0Line = P(lineI, a0);
  const i0Arc = P(inner, a0 + dI);
  const i1Arc = P(inner, a1 - dI);
  const i1Line = P(lineI, a1);
  const innerLarge = span - 2 * dI > Math.PI ? 1 : 0;
  return (
    `M${s(i0Line)}L${s(o0Line)}A${R} ${R} 0 0 1 ${s(o0Arc)}` +
    `A${r(outer)} ${r(outer)} 0 ${outerLarge} 1 ${s(o1Arc)}A${R} ${R} 0 0 1 ${s(o1Line)}` +
    `L${s(i1Line)}A${R} ${R} 0 0 1 ${s(i1Arc)}` +
    `A${r(inner)} ${r(inner)} 0 ${innerLarge} 0 ${s(i0Arc)}A${R} ${R} 0 0 1 ${s(i0Line)}Z`
  );
}

/** An open arc along one radius, for stroked rings and gauges. */
export function ringPath(cx: number, cy: number, radius: number, start: number, end: number): string {
  const sweep = Math.min(end - start, Math.PI * 2 - 1e-3);
  if (sweep <= 0) return '';
  const a = polar(cx, cy, radius, start);
  const b = polar(cx, cy, radius, start + sweep);
  return `M${pt(a.x, a.y)}A${r(radius)} ${r(radius)} 0 ${sweep > Math.PI ? 1 : 0} 1 ${pt(b.x, b.y)}`;
}
```

### `ui/components/chart/radial-chart.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import type { ReactNode } from 'react';
import { ChartContainer } from './chart-container';
import { ChartTooltip, TooltipContent } from './chart-tooltip';
import { createValueFormatter } from './format';
import { ringPath } from './path';
import { clamp, toNumber } from './scale';
import { chartVars, resolveColor, seriesVar } from './series';
import type { ChartDatum, LegendPosition, SeriesColor, ValueFormat } from './types';
import { useSweep, useTweenedData } from './use-chart-motion';
import { useIndexInteraction } from './use-index-interaction';
import { useSeriesVisibility } from './use-series-visibility';

export interface RadialChartProps {
  data: ChartDatum[];
  /** Key of the ring name in each record. */
  index: string;
  /** Key of the ring value in each record. */
  valueKey: string;
  /** Value that fills a ring completely. */
  max?: number;
  colors?: SeriesColor[];
  /** 'ring' draws concentric full circles; 'semicircle' is a gauge. */
  variant?: 'ring' | 'semicircle';
  /** Defaults to 240 (ring) or 160 (semicircle). */
  height?: number;
  /** Stroke width of a ring in px. */
  thickness?: number;
  /** Draw the empty track behind each ring. */
  track?: boolean;
  centerLabel?: ReactNode;
  centerValue?: ReactNode;
  valueFormat?: ValueFormat;
  locale?: string;
  legend?: LegendPosition;
  tooltip?: boolean;
  animate?: boolean;
  'aria-label'?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/** Progress toward a goal: one ring, several concentric rings, or a semicircle gauge. */
export function RadialChart({
  data,
  index,
  valueKey,
  max = 100,
  colors,
  variant = 'ring',
  height,
  thickness,
  track = true,
  centerLabel,
  centerValue,
  valueFormat,
  locale,
  legend,
  tooltip = true,
  animate = true,
  className,
  ...rest
}: RadialChartProps) {
  const h = height ?? (variant === 'semicircle' ? 160 : 240);
  const [hidden, toggle] = useSeriesVisibility();
  const shown = useTweenedData(data, [valueKey], animate);
  const fmt = createValueFormatter(valueFormat, locale);
  const names = data.map((row) => String(row[index] ?? ''));
  const cols = data.map((_, i) => resolveColor(colors?.[i], i));
  const name =
    rest['aria-label'] ??
    `${variant === 'semicircle' ? 'Gauge' : 'Radial chart'}: ${data.map((row, i) => `${names[i]} ${fmt(toNumber(row[valueKey]) ?? 0)} of ${fmt(max)}`).join(', ')}.`;

  return (
    <ChartContainer
      height={h}
      vars={chartVars(cols)}
      legend={legend ?? (data.length > 1 ? 'bottom' : false)}
      legendItems={data.map((_, i) => ({ key: names[i]!, label: names[i]!, color: seriesVar(i), visible: !hidden.has(names[i]!) }))}
      onLegendToggle={(key) => toggle(key, data.length)}
      className={className}
      table={{
        caption: name,
        columns: [index, valueKey, 'Goal'],
        rows: data.map((row, i) => [names[i]!, fmt(toNumber(row[valueKey]) ?? 0), fmt(max)]),
      }}
    >
      {(width) => (
        <RadialPlot
          width={width}
          height={h}
          rows={shown}
          names={names}
          hidden={hidden}
          valueKey={valueKey}
          max={max}
          semicircle={variant === 'semicircle'}
          thickness={thickness}
          track={track}
          centerLabel={centerLabel}
          centerValue={centerValue}
          fmt={fmt}
          showTooltip={tooltip}
          animate={animate}
          label={name}
        />
      )}
    </ChartContainer>
  );
}

interface RadialPlotProps {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  rows: ChartDatum[];
  names: string[];
  hidden: ReadonlySet<string>;
  valueKey: string;
  max: number;
  semicircle: boolean;
  thickness?: number;
  track: boolean;
  centerLabel?: ReactNode;
  centerValue?: ReactNode;
  fmt: (v: number) => string;
  showTooltip: boolean;
  animate: boolean;
  label: string;
}

function RadialPlot(p: RadialPlotProps) {
  const sweep = useSweep(p.animate);
  const rings = p.rows
    .map((row, i) => ({ i, value: toNumber(row[p.valueKey]) ?? 0 }))
    .filter((r) => !p.hidden.has(p.names[r.i]!));
  const n = rings.length;

  const outerR = p.semicircle ? Math.min(p.width / 2 - 4, p.height - 14) : Math.min(p.width, p.height) / 2 - 4;
  const cx = p.width / 2;
  const cy = p.semicircle ? p.height - 6 : p.height / 2;
  const gap = 4;
  const stroke = Math.max(4, Math.min(p.thickness ?? (n > 1 ? 12 : 16), (outerR - 12) / Math.max(n, 1) - gap));
  const start = p.semicircle ? -Math.PI / 2 : 0;
  const range = p.semicircle ? Math.PI : Math.PI * 2;
  const radius = (k: number) => outerR - stroke / 2 - k * (stroke + gap);

  const { active, props } = useIndexInteraction(n, (x, y) => {
    const dist = Math.hypot(x - cx, y - cy);
    const k = Math.floor((outerR - dist) / (stroke + gap));
    return dist > outerR + 4 || k < 0 || k >= n ? -1 : k;
  });
  const { ref, ...handlers } = props;
  const k = active.index != null && active.index >= 0 && active.index < n ? active.index : null;
  const current = k != null ? rings[k] : null;
  const frac = (v: number) => clamp(v / (p.max || 1), 0, 1);

  let label: ReactNode = p.centerLabel;
  let value: ReactNode = p.centerValue;
  if (current) {
    label = p.names[current.i];
    value = p.fmt(current.value);
  } else if (n === 1) {
    label = p.centerLabel ?? p.names[rings[0]!.i];
    value = p.centerValue ?? p.fmt(rings[0]!.value);
  }
  const showCenter = (value != null || label != null) && (p.semicircle || outerR - n * (stroke + gap) > 28);
  const tipX = active.source === 'pointer' ? active.x : cx;
  const tipY = active.source === 'pointer' ? active.y : cy - radius(k ?? 0);

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      className="ui-chart-stage"
      role="group"
      aria-label={`${p.label} Use the arrow keys to move between rings.`}
      style={{ width: p.width, height: p.height }}
      data-active={current ? 'true' : 'false'}
      {...handlers}
    >
      <svg width={p.width} height={p.height} viewBox={`0 0 ${p.width} ${p.height}`} role="img" aria-label={p.label}>
        {rings.map((r, k2) => {
          const rad = radius(k2);
          const on = k === k2;
          return (
            <g key={p.names[r.i]} data-dim={k != null && !on ? 'true' : 'false'} className="ui-chart-ring" aria-hidden="true">
              {p.track && <path d={ringPath(cx, cy, rad, start, start + range)} className="ui-chart-track" strokeWidth={stroke} strokeLinecap="round" fill="none" />}
              <path
                d={ringPath(cx, cy, rad, start, start + range * frac(r.value) * sweep)}
                className="ui-chart-ring-value"
                style={{ stroke: seriesVar(r.i) }}
                strokeWidth={on ? stroke + 2 : stroke}
                strokeLinecap="round"
                fill="none"
              />
            </g>
          );
        })}
      </svg>
      {showCenter && (
        <div
          className="ui-chart-center"
          data-variant={p.semicircle ? 'semicircle' : undefined}
          style={p.semicircle ? { top: cy - 4, transform: 'translate(-50%, -100%)' } : undefined}
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          {label != null && <div className="ui-chart-center-label">{label}</div>}
          {value != null && <div className="ui-chart-center-value">{value}</div>}
        </div>
      )}
      {p.showTooltip && n > 1 && (
        <ChartTooltip visible={!!current} x={tipX} y={tipY} width={p.width} height={p.height}>
          {current && <TooltipContent rows={[{ color: seriesVar(current.i), name: p.names[current.i]!, value: `${p.fmt(current.value)} of ${p.fmt(p.max)}` }]} />}
        </ChartTooltip>
      )}
      <div className="ui-chart-sr" role="status" aria-live="polite">
        {active.source === 'keyboard' && current ? `${p.names[current.i]}: ${p.fmt(current.value)} of ${p.fmt(p.max)}` : ''}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### `ui/components/chart/scale.ts`

```ts
/** Scales, "nice" ticks and stacking. Pure functions, no DOM. */

export interface LinearScale {
  (value: number): number;
  domain: [number, number];
  range: [number, number];
  invert(px: number): number;
}

export function linearScale(domain: [number, number], range: [number, number]): LinearScale {
  const [d0, d1] = domain;
  const [r0, r1] = range;
  const span = d1 - d0 || 1;
  const fn = ((v: number) => r0 + ((v - d0) / span) * (r1 - r0)) as LinearScale;
  fn.domain = domain;
  fn.range = range;
  fn.invert = (px) => d0 + ((px - r0) / (r1 - r0 || 1)) * span;
  return fn;
}

export interface BandScale {
  (index: number): number;
  bandwidth: number;
  step: number;
  count: number;
  /** The band whose slot (band plus half the padding each side) contains `px`. */
  indexAt(px: number): number;
}

export function bandScale(
  count: number,
  range: [number, number],
  { paddingInner = 0.2, paddingOuter = 0.1 }: { paddingInner?: number; paddingOuter?: number } = {},
): BandScale {
  const [r0, r1] = range;
  const n = Math.max(count, 1);
  const step = (r1 - r0) / Math.max(n - paddingInner + 2 * paddingOuter, 1e-6);
  const bandwidth = step * (1 - paddingInner);
  const start = r0 + (r1 - r0 - step * (n - paddingInner)) / 2;
  const fn = ((i: number) => start + step * i) as BandScale;
  fn.bandwidth = bandwidth;
  fn.step = step;
  fn.count = count;
  fn.indexAt = (px) => {
    const i = Math.floor((px - (start - (step - bandwidth) / 2)) / step);
    return Math.min(Math.max(i, 0), Math.max(count - 1, 0));
  };
  return fn;
}

/** The nearest "nice" step (1, 2, 5 x 10^n) at or above `raw`. */
export function niceStep(raw: number): number {
  if (!(raw > 0) || !Number.isFinite(raw)) return 1;
  const p = 10 ** Math.floor(Math.log10(raw));
  const f = raw / p;
  return (f <= 1 ? 1 : f <= 2 ? 2 : f <= 5 ? 5 : 10) * p;
}

export interface NiceScale {
  min: number;
  max: number;
  step: number;
  ticks: number[];
}

/** Extend [min, max] to round numbers and list the ticks between (about `count`). */
export function niceScale(min: number, max: number, count = 5): NiceScale {
  if (!Number.isFinite(min) || !Number.isFinite(max)) {
    min = 0;
    max = 1;
  }
  if (min > max) [min, max] = [max, min];
  if (min === max) {
    if (min === 0) max = 1;
    else {
      const pad = Math.abs(min) * 0.1;
      min -= pad;
      max += pad;
    }
  }
  const step = niceStep((max - min) / Math.max(1, count));
  const lo = Math.floor(min / step + 1e-9) * step;
  const hi = Math.ceil(max / step - 1e-9) * step;
  const digits = Math.min(12, Math.max(0, -Math.floor(Math.log10(step))) + 2);
  const total = Math.round((hi - lo) / step);
  const ticks: number[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i <= total; i++) ticks.push(Number((lo + i * step).toFixed(digits)));
  return { min: ticks[0]!, max: ticks[ticks.length - 1]!, step, ticks };
}

/** A finite number from a number or numeric string; otherwise null. */
export function toNumber(v: unknown): number | null {
  if (typeof v === 'number') return Number.isFinite(v) ? v : null;
  if (typeof v === 'string' && v.trim() !== '') {
    const n = Number(v);
    return Number.isFinite(n) ? n : null;
  }
  return null;
}

export interface StackBand {
  lo: number;
  hi: number;
}

/**
 * Stack series on top of each other. Positive values stack up from 0, negative
 * values stack down from 0, so mixed-sign data never overlaps.
 */
export function stackSeries(data: Record<string, unknown>[], keys: string[]): StackBand[][] {
  const out: StackBand[][] = keys.map(() => []);
  data.forEach((row) => {
    let pos = 0;
    let neg = 0;
    keys.forEach((key, k) => {
      const v = toNumber(row[key]) ?? 0;
      if (v >= 0) {
        out[k]!.push({ lo: pos, hi: pos + v });
        pos += v;
      } else {
        out[k]!.push({ lo: neg + v, hi: neg });
        neg += v;
      }
    });
  });
  return out;
}

export const clamp = (v: number, lo: number, hi: number) => Math.min(Math.max(v, lo), hi);
```

### `ui/components/chart/series.ts`

```ts
import type { CSSProperties } from 'react';
import type { ChartDatum, ChartSeries, SeriesColor } from './types';

export interface ResolvedSeries {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  /** A CSS colour expression, e.g. `var(--ui-series-1)`. */
  color: string;
  /** Position in the original `series` array: stable when others are hidden. */
  index: number;
}

export function resolveColor(color: SeriesColor | undefined, i: number): string {
  if (!color) return `var(--ui-series-${(i % 6) + 1})`;
  return /^series-[1-6]$/.test(color) ? `var(--ui-${color})` : color;
}

export function resolveSeries(series: ChartSeries[]): ResolvedSeries[] {
  return series.map((s, i) => ({ key: s.key, label: s.label ?? s.key, color: resolveColor(s.color, i), index: i }));
}

/** CSS custom properties `--ui-chart-c0 ... cN`: marks reference these, so themes switch with no re-render. */
export function chartVars(colors: string[]): CSSProperties {
  const vars: Record<string, string> = {};
  colors.forEach((c, i) => {
    vars[`--ui-chart-c${i}`] = c;
  });
  return vars as CSSProperties;
}

export const seriesVar = (i: number) => `var(--ui-chart-c${i})`;

export const defaultLabel = (v: string | number) => String(v);

/** Index value of a row as string or number. */
export function indexValue(row: ChartDatum, key: string): string | number {
  const v = row[key];
  return typeof v === 'number' || typeof v === 'string' ? v : v == null ? '' : String(v);
}

/** Pixels needed for the longest label (12px tabular text, approximate). */
export function labelWidth(labels: string[]): number {
  return labels.reduce((m, l) => Math.max(m, l.length), 1) * 6.4 + 4;
}

/** A short sentence describing the chart for assistive tech. */
export function summarize(kind: string, count: number, series: ResolvedSeries[], first?: string, last?: string): string {
  const names = series.map((s) => s.label).join(', ');
  const range = first && last && count > 1 ? ` from ${first} to ${last}` : '';
  return `${kind} of ${names}, ${count} ${count === 1 ? 'point' : 'points'}${range}.`;
}
```

### `ui/components/chart/sparkline.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { useId, useMemo } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { createValueFormatter } from './format';
import { areaPath, barPath, linePath, type Curve, type Point } from './path';
import { bandScale, linearScale, toNumber } from './scale';
import { resolveColor } from './series';
import type { ChartDatum, SeriesColor, ValueFormat } from './types';
import { useEntrance } from './use-chart-motion';
import { useChartSize } from './use-chart-size';

export interface SparklineProps {
  /** Numbers, or records read through `valueKey`. */
  data: (number | ChartDatum)[];
  valueKey?: string;
  variant?: 'line' | 'area' | 'bar';
  /** Fixed width in px. Fills the parent when omitted. */
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  color?: SeriesColor;
  /** Colour by direction: success when the last value is above the first, destructive when below. */
  trend?: boolean;
  curve?: Curve;
  /** Dot on the last point (line and area). */
  dot?: boolean;
  strokeWidth?: number;
  valueFormat?: ValueFormat;
  animate?: boolean;
  'aria-label'?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/** A tiny trend line for tiles and table rows: no axes, no tooltip. */
export function Sparkline({
  data,
  valueKey = 'value',
  variant = 'line',
  width,
  height = 32,
  color,
  trend = false,
  curve = 'monotone',
  dot = true,
  strokeWidth = 1.5,
  valueFormat,
  animate = true,
  className,
  ...rest
}: SparklineProps) {
  const { ref, width: measured } = useChartSize<HTMLDivElement>();
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, '');
  const values = useMemo(
    () => data.map((d) => (typeof d === 'number' ? d : toNumber(d[valueKey]))).filter((v): v is number => v !== null),
    [data, valueKey],
  );
  const first = values[0] ?? 0;
  const last = values[values.length - 1] ?? 0;
  const stroke = trend && values.length > 1 && last !== first ? (last > first ? 'var(--ui-success)' : 'var(--ui-destructive)') : resolveColor(color, 0);
  const fmt = createValueFormatter(valueFormat);
  const name = rest['aria-label'] ?? (values.length ? `Trend, ${values.length} points, from ${fmt(first)} to ${fmt(last)}.` : 'No data');

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-sparkline', className)} style={{ width: width ?? '100%', height }}>
      {measured > 0 && values.length > 0 && (
        <SparkSvg width={measured} height={height} values={values} variant={variant} curve={curve} dot={dot} stroke={stroke} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} uid={uid} animate={animate} label={name} />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function SparkSvg({
  width,
  height,
  values,
  variant,
  curve,
  dot,
  stroke,
  strokeWidth,
  uid,
  animate,
  label,
}: {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  values: number[];
  variant: 'line' | 'area' | 'bar';
  curve: Curve;
  dot: boolean;
  stroke: string;
  strokeWidth: number;
  uid: string;
  animate: boolean;
  label: string;
}) {
  const svgRef = useMemo(() => ({ current: null as SVGSVGElement | null }), []);
  useEntrance(svgRef, animate);
  const pad = 3;
  const n = values.length;
  let min = Math.min(...values);
  let max = Math.max(...values);
  if (variant === 'bar') {
    min = Math.min(min, 0);
    max = Math.max(max, 0);
  }
  if (min === max) {
    min -= 1;
    max += 1;
  }
  const ys = linearScale([min, max], [height - pad, pad]);

  let body;
  if (variant === 'bar') {
    const band = bandScale(n, [0, width], { paddingInner: 0.35, paddingOuter: 0 });
    const zero = ys(0);
    body = values.map((v, i) => {
      const y = ys(v);
      const top = Math.min(y, zero);
      const h = Math.max(Math.abs(zero - y), 1);
      return (
        <path
          key={i}
          d={barPath(band(i), top, band.bandwidth, h, Math.min(1.5, band.bandwidth / 2), v >= 0 ? 'top' : 'bottom')}
          fill={stroke}
          opacity={i === n - 1 ? 1 : 0.45}
          data-grow=""
          data-axis="y"
          data-origin={v >= 0 ? '50% 100%' : '50% 0%'}
        />
      );
    });
  } else {
    const xs = (i: number) => (n === 1 ? width / 2 : pad + (i * (width - pad * 2)) / (n - 1));
    const pts: Point[] = values.map((v, i) => ({ x: xs(i), y: ys(v) }));
    const lastPt = pts[n - 1];
    body = (
      <>
        {variant === 'area' && (
          <>
            <defs>
              <linearGradient id={`${uid}-g`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                <stop offset="0%" stopColor={stroke} stopOpacity={0.3} />
                <stop offset="100%" stopColor={stroke} stopOpacity={0} />
              </linearGradient>
            </defs>
            <path d={areaPath(pts, height, curve)} fill={`url(#${uid}-g)`} data-fade="" />
          </>
        )}
        <path d={linePath(pts, curve)} fill="none" stroke={stroke} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" data-draw="" />
        {dot && lastPt && <circle className="ui-sparkline-dot" cx={lastPt.x} cy={lastPt.y} r={2.5} fill={stroke} />}
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <svg
      ref={(el) => {
        svgRef.current = el;
      }}
      width={width}
      height={height}
      viewBox={`0 0 ${width} ${height}`}
      role="img"
      aria-label={label}
      style={{ display: 'block', overflow: 'visible' }}
    >
      {body}
    </svg>
  );
}
```

### `ui/components/chart/types.ts`

```ts
import type { Curve } from './path';
import type { ValueFormat } from './format';

export type { Curve, ValueFormat };

/** `'series-1'` ... `'series-6'` pick a theme colour; any other string is used as a CSS colour. */
export type SeriesColor = 'series-1' | 'series-2' | 'series-3' | 'series-4' | 'series-5' | 'series-6' | (string & {});

export interface ChartSeries {
  /** Key of the value in each data record. */
  key: string;
  /** Name shown in the legend and tooltip. Defaults to the key. */
  label?: string;
  color?: SeriesColor;
}

export type ChartDatum = Record<string, unknown>;
export type LegendPosition = 'top' | 'bottom' | false;
export type GridOption = boolean | 'horizontal' | 'vertical' | 'both';

export interface XAxisOptions {
  /** Format an index value for the axis. Falls back to `indexFormat`. */
  format?: (value: string | number, index: number) => string;
}

export interface YAxisOptions {
  /** Format a tick. Falls back to a compact `valueFormat`. */
  format?: (value: number) => string;
  /** Approximate number of ticks (the scale rounds to nice numbers). */
  ticks?: number;
  /** Fixed width in px for the label column. */
  width?: number;
  /** Fix either end of the domain; 'auto' keeps it computed. */
  domain?: [number | 'auto', number | 'auto'];
}

export interface TooltipOptions {
  /** Format the heading (the index value). Falls back to `indexFormat`. */
  labelFormat?: (value: string | number, index: number) => string;
}

/** Props shared by every chart. */
export interface ChartBaseProps {
  data: ChartDatum[];
  /** Key of the x value (the category or date) in each record. */
  index: string;
  series: ChartSeries[];
  /** Height of the plot in px. */
  height?: number;
  valueFormat?: ValueFormat;
  /** Format the index value everywhere it is shown (axis, tooltip, table). */
  indexFormat?: (value: string | number, index: number) => string;
  legend?: LegendPosition;
  tooltip?: boolean | TooltipOptions;
  /** Draw-in motion on mount and smooth transitions between data. Respects reduced motion. */
  animate?: boolean;
  /** Accessible name; a summary of the data is generated when omitted. */
  'aria-label'?: string;
  /** Locale for number formatting. */
  locale?: string;
  className?: string;
}

/** Props shared by the cartesian charts (line, area, bar). */
export interface CartesianChartProps extends ChartBaseProps {
  /** The bottom axis. */
  xAxis?: boolean | XAxisOptions;
  /** The left axis. */
  yAxis?: boolean | YAxisOptions;
  grid?: GridOption;
}
```
