### `ui/components/chart/use-chart-motion.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type RefObject } from 'react';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';
import { toNumber } from './scale';

const EASE = 'cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)';
const easeOut = (k: number) => 1 - (1 - k) ** 4;

export function prefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
  return typeof window !== 'undefined' && !!window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
}

/**
 * Entrance motion, played once when the plot first mounts (the plot only mounts
 * on the client, after measuring, so there is no hydration flash). Marks opt in
 * with data attributes:
 *   data-draw   line: stroke draws in (dasharray from getTotalLength)
 *   data-fade   area: fades up
 *   data-grow   bar: grows from its baseline (data-axis x|y, data-origin css origin, data-order stagger index)
 * Everything is <= 700ms, ease-out, and skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.
 */
export function useEntrance(rootRef: RefObject<Element | null>, enabled: boolean) {
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    const root = rootRef.current;
    if (!root || !enabled || prefersReducedMotion() || typeof Element.prototype.animate !== 'function') return;
    const anims: Animation[] = [];

    root.querySelectorAll<SVGGeometryElement>('[data-draw]').forEach((el) => {
      const len = typeof el.getTotalLength === 'function' ? el.getTotalLength() : 0;
      if (!len) return;
      const delay = Math.min(Number(el.dataset.order ?? 0) * 40, 100);
      anims.push(
        el.animate(
          { strokeDasharray: [`${len} ${len}`, `${len} ${len}`], strokeDashoffset: [len, 0] },
          { duration: 600, delay, easing: EASE, fill: 'backwards' },
        ),
      );
    });

    root.querySelectorAll<SVGElement>('[data-fade]').forEach((el) => {
      const delay = Math.min(Number(el.dataset.order ?? 0) * 40, 100);
      anims.push(
        el.animate(
          { opacity: [0, 1], transform: ['translateY(8px)', 'translateY(0)'] },
          { duration: 600, delay, easing: EASE, fill: 'backwards' },
        ),
      );
    });

    const bars = root.querySelectorAll<SVGElement>('[data-grow]');
    const stagger = Math.min(30, 200 / Math.max(bars.length, 1));
    bars.forEach((el, i) => {
      const x = el.dataset.axis === 'x';
      el.style.transformBox = 'fill-box';
      el.style.transformOrigin = el.dataset.origin ?? (x ? '0% 50%' : '50% 100%');
      anims.push(
        el.animate(
          { transform: [x ? 'scale(0, 1)' : 'scale(1, 0)', 'scale(1, 1)'] },
          { duration: 500, delay: i * stagger, easing: EASE, fill: 'backwards' },
        ),
      );
    });

    return () => anims.forEach((a) => a.cancel());
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);
}

/** 0 -> 1 on mount (ease-out, 700ms) for sweeps; 1 straight away when disabled or reduced motion. */
export function useSweep(enabled: boolean, duration = 700): number {
  const [p, setP] = useState(enabled ? 0 : 1);
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled || prefersReducedMotion()) {
      setP(1);
      return;
    }
    let raf = 0;
    let t0 = 0;
    const tick = (t: number) => {
      t0 = t0 || t;
      const k = Math.min(1, (t - t0) / duration);
      setP(easeOut(k));
      if (k < 1) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, []);
  return p;
}

/** Smoothly move displayed numbers toward new targets. Snaps when the length changes. */
export function useTweenedNumbers(target: number[], enabled: boolean, duration = 450): number[] {
  const [value, setValue] = useState(target);
  const shown = useRef(target);
  const sig = target.join(',');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const from = shown.current;
    if (from.length === target.length && from.every((v, i) => Object.is(v, target[i]))) return;
    if (prefersReducedMotion() || from.length !== target.length) {
      shown.current = target;
      setValue(target);
      return;
    }
    let raf = 0;
    let t0 = 0;
    const tick = (t: number) => {
      t0 = t0 || t;
      const k = easeOut(Math.min(1, (t - t0) / duration));
      const next = target.map((to, i) => (Number.isNaN(to) || Number.isNaN(from[i]) ? to : from[i]! + (to - from[i]!) * k));
      shown.current = next;
      setValue(next);
      if (t - t0 < duration) raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(tick);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [sig, enabled]);

  if (!enabled || value.length !== target.length) return target;
  return value;
}

/** `data` with the values of `keys` eased toward their latest numbers. Returns `data` itself when not animating. */
export function useTweenedData(data: Record<string, unknown>[], keys: string[], enabled: boolean): Record<string, unknown>[] {
  const flat = data.flatMap((row) => keys.map((k) => toNumber(row[k]) ?? Number.NaN));
  const tw = useTweenedNumbers(flat, enabled);
  const keySig = keys.join('|');
  return useMemo(() => {
    if (!enabled) return data;
    return data.map((row, i) => {
      const out = { ...row };
      keys.forEach((k, j) => {
        const v = tw[i * keys.length + j];
        out[k] = Number.isNaN(v) ? null : v;
      });
      return out;
    });
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [data, tw, enabled, keySig]);
}
```

### `ui/components/chart/use-chart-size.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useRef, useState, type RefObject } from 'react';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';

/**
 * Width of an element, kept in sync with a ResizeObserver.
 * Returns 0 until measured (always on the server), so charts render a
 * correctly sized placeholder first and never touch `window` during render.
 */
export function useChartSize<T extends HTMLElement>(): { ref: RefObject<T | null>; width: number } {
  const ref = useRef<T | null>(null);
  const [width, setWidth] = useState(0);

  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const read = () => setWidth(Math.round(el.getBoundingClientRect().width));
    read();
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(read);
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, []);

  return { ref, width };
}
```

### `ui/components/chart/use-index-interaction.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState, type KeyboardEvent, type PointerEvent } from 'react';

export interface ActiveState {
  index: number | null;
  /** Pointer position inside the stage (px). Only meaningful when `source` is 'pointer'. */
  x: number;
  y: number;
  source: 'pointer' | 'touch' | 'keyboard' | null;
}

const NONE: ActiveState = { index: null, x: 0, y: 0, source: null };

/**
 * Active-index state for a chart stage: the nearest index follows the pointer
 * (mouse, pen or touch), arrow keys move it, Esc clears it. Touch keeps the
 * readout until the next tap elsewhere.
 */
export function useIndexInteraction(count: number, indexAt: (x: number, y: number) => number) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
  const [active, setActive] = useState<ActiveState>(NONE);
  const indexAtRef = useRef(indexAt);
  indexAtRef.current = indexAt;

  const fromPointer = useCallback(
    (e: PointerEvent) => {
      const el = ref.current;
      if (!el || count === 0) return;
      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
      const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
      const index = indexAtRef.current(x, y);
      setActive((prev) =>
        prev.index === index && prev.x === x && prev.y === y ? prev : { index, x, y, source: e.pointerType === 'touch' ? 'touch' : 'pointer' },
      );
    },
    [count],
  );

  const onKeyDown = useCallback(
    (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (count === 0) return;
      let delta = 0;
      let to: number | null = null;
      if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') delta = 1;
      else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') delta = -1;
      else if (e.key === 'Home') to = 0;
      else if (e.key === 'End') to = count - 1;
      else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        setActive(NONE);
        return;
      } else return;
      e.preventDefault();
      setActive((prev) => {
        const base = prev.index;
        const index = to ?? (base == null ? (delta > 0 ? 0 : count - 1) : Math.min(Math.max(base + delta, 0), count - 1));
        return { index, x: 0, y: 0, source: 'keyboard' };
      });
    },
    [count],
  );

  // A tap outside dismisses a touch readout
  useEffect(() => {
    if (active.source !== 'touch') return;
    const off = (e: globalThis.PointerEvent) => {
      if (!ref.current?.contains(e.target as Node)) setActive(NONE);
    };
    document.addEventListener('pointerdown', off);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('pointerdown', off);
  }, [active.source]);

  // Data shrank under an active index
  useEffect(() => {
    setActive((prev) => (prev.index != null && prev.index >= count ? NONE : prev));
  }, [count]);

  const props = {
    ref,
    tabIndex: 0,
    onPointerMove: fromPointer,
    onPointerDown: fromPointer,
    onPointerLeave: (e: PointerEvent) => {
      if (e.pointerType !== 'touch') setActive(NONE);
    },
    onKeyDown,
    onBlur: () => setActive((prev) => (prev.source === 'keyboard' ? NONE : prev)),
  };

  return { active, props, clear: () => setActive(NONE) };
}
```

### `ui/components/chart/use-series-visibility.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useState } from 'react';

/** Hidden-series state for legend toggling. The last visible series cannot be hidden. */
export function useSeriesVisibility(): [ReadonlySet<string>, (key: string, total: number) => void] {
  const [hidden, setHidden] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(() => new Set());
  const toggle = useCallback((key: string, total: number) => {
    setHidden((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(key)) next.delete(key);
      else if (total - next.size > 1) next.add(key);
      else return prev;
      return next;
    });
  }, []);
  return [hidden, toggle];
}
```

### `ui/components/chart/xy-chart.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { useId, useMemo, useRef } from 'react';
import { CartesianStage } from './cartesian-stage';
import { ChartAxes } from './chart-axes';
import { ChartContainer } from './chart-container';
import { createAxisFormatter, createValueFormatter } from './format';
import { axisOptions, gridFlags, tooltipOptions } from './options';
import type { Curve } from './path';
import { chartVars, defaultLabel, indexValue, resolveSeries, seriesVar, summarize, type ResolvedSeries } from './series';
import { toNumber } from './scale';
import type { CartesianChartProps, ChartDatum, XAxisOptions, YAxisOptions } from './types';
import { useTweenedData } from './use-chart-motion';
import { useSeriesVisibility } from './use-series-visibility';
import { computeXY } from './xy-geometry';

export interface XYChartProps extends CartesianChartProps {
  variant: 'line' | 'area';
  stacked?: boolean;
  curve?: Curve;
}

/** Shared implementation of LineChart and AreaChart. */
export function XYChart(props: XYChartProps) {
  const {
    data,
    index,
    series,
    variant,
    stacked = false,
    height = 280,
    valueFormat,
    indexFormat,
    locale,
    xAxis,
    yAxis,
    grid,
    legend,
    tooltip,
    curve = 'monotone',
    animate = true,
    className,
  } = props;

  const all = useMemo(() => resolveSeries(series), [series]);
  const [hidden, toggle] = useSeriesVisibility();
  const visible = all.filter((s) => !hidden.has(s.key));
  const shown = useTweenedData(data, all.map((s) => s.key), animate);
  const fmtIndex = indexFormat ?? defaultLabel;
  const fmt = createValueFormatter(valueFormat, locale);
  const x = axisOptions<XAxisOptions>(xAxis);
  const tip = tooltipOptions(tooltip);
  const labelOf = (row: ChartDatum, i: number) => fmtIndex(indexValue(row, index), i);
  const first = data.length ? labelOf(data[0]!, 0) : undefined;
  const last = data.length ? labelOf(data[data.length - 1]!, data.length - 1) : undefined;
  const name = props['aria-label'] ?? summarize(variant === 'line' ? 'Line chart' : stacked ? 'Stacked area chart' : 'Area chart', data.length, visible, first, last);
  const legendPos = legend ?? (all.length > 1 ? 'bottom' : false);

  return (
    <ChartContainer
      height={height}
      vars={chartVars(all.map((s) => s.color))}
      legend={legendPos}
      legendItems={all.map((s) => ({ key: s.key, label: s.label, color: seriesVar(s.index), visible: !hidden.has(s.key) }))}
      onLegendToggle={(key) => toggle(key, all.length)}
      className={className}
      table={{
        caption: name,
        columns: [index, ...all.map((s) => s.label)],
        rows: data.map((row, i) => [labelOf(row, i), ...all.map((s) => { const v = toNumber(row[s.key]); return v == null ? '' : fmt(v); })]),
      }}
    >
      {(width) => (
        <XYPlot
          width={width}
          height={height}
          data={shown}
          rawData={data}
          index={index}
          visible={visible}
          variant={variant}
          stacked={stacked}
          curve={curve}
          showX={x.show}
          xFormat={x.options.format ?? fmtIndex}
          tooltipFormat={tip.options.labelFormat ?? fmtIndex}
          showTooltip={tip.show}
          showY={axisOptions<YAxisOptions>(yAxis).show}
          yOptions={axisOptions<YAxisOptions>(yAxis).options}
          grid={gridFlags(grid)}
          fmt={fmt}
          fmtAxis={createAxisFormatter(valueFormat, locale)}
          animate={animate}
          label={name}
        />
      )}
    </ChartContainer>
  );
}

interface XYPlotProps {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  data: ChartDatum[];
  rawData: ChartDatum[];
  index: string;
  visible: ResolvedSeries[];
  variant: 'line' | 'area';
  stacked: boolean;
  curve: Curve;
  showX: boolean;
  xFormat: (v: string | number, i: number) => string;
  tooltipFormat: (v: string | number, i: number) => string;
  showTooltip: boolean;
  showY: boolean;
  yOptions: YAxisOptions;
  grid: { h: boolean; v: boolean };
  fmt: (v: number) => string;
  fmtAxis: (v: number) => string;
  animate: boolean;
  label: string;
}

function XYPlot(p: XYPlotProps) {
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, '');
  const lastIdx = useRef(0);
  const formatY = p.yOptions.format ?? p.fmtAxis;
  const xLabels = useMemo(() => p.rawData.map((row, i) => p.xFormat(indexValue(row, p.index), i)), [p.rawData, p.index, p.xFormat]);

  const geo = useMemo(
    () =>
      computeXY({
        width: p.width,
        height: p.height,
        data: p.data,
        visible: p.visible,
        variant: p.variant,
        stacked: p.stacked,
        curve: p.curve,
        showX: p.showX,
        showY: p.showY,
        yOptions: p.yOptions,
        formatY,
        xLabels,
      }),
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    [p.width, p.height, p.data, p.visible, p.variant, p.stacked, p.curve, p.showX, p.showY, p.yOptions, formatY, xLabels],
  );

  const marks = useMemo(
    () => (
      <>
        {p.variant === 'area' && (
          <defs>
            {geo.lines.map((l) => (
              <linearGradient key={l.series.key} id={`${uid}-${l.series.index}`} x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
                <stop offset="0%" stopColor={seriesVar(l.series.index)} stopOpacity={p.stacked ? 0.55 : 0.34} />
                <stop offset="100%" stopColor={seriesVar(l.series.index)} stopOpacity={p.stacked ? 0.12 : 0} />
              </linearGradient>
            ))}
          </defs>
        )}
        <ChartAxes
          plot={geo.plot}
          hTicks={geo.hTicks}
          vTicks={geo.vTicks}
          gridH={p.grid.h}
          gridV={p.grid.v}
          leftLabels={p.showY}
          bottomLabels={p.showX}
          zero={geo.zeroY != null ? { pos: geo.zeroY, orient: 'h' } : null}
        />
        {geo.lines.map((l, order) =>
          l.area ? (
            <path key={`a-${l.series.key}`} d={l.area} fill={`url(#${uid}-${l.series.index})`} data-fade="" data-order={order} />
          ) : null,
        )}
        {geo.lines.map((l, order) => (
          <path
            key={`l-${l.series.key}`}
            d={l.d}
            className="ui-chart-line"
            style={{ stroke: seriesVar(l.series.index) }}
            data-draw=""
            data-order={order}
          />
        ))}
        {p.rawData.length === 1 &&
          geo.lines.map((l) =>
            l.points[0] ? <circle key={`s-${l.series.key}`} cx={l.points[0].x} cy={l.points[0].y} r={3.5} fill={seriesVar(l.series.index)} /> : null,
          )}
      </>
    ),
    [geo, uid, p.variant, p.stacked, p.grid, p.showX, p.showY, p.rawData.length],
  );

  const readout = (i: number) => ({
    label: p.tooltipFormat(indexValue(p.rawData[i]!, p.index), i),
    rows: p.visible.map((s) => {
      const v = toNumber(p.rawData[i]![s.key]);
      return { color: seriesVar(s.index), name: s.label, value: v == null ? '—' : p.fmt(v) };
    }),
  });

  return (
    <CartesianStage
      width={p.width}
      height={p.height}
      ariaLabel={p.label}
      count={p.data.length}
      indexAt={(px) => geo.indexAt(px)}
      marks={marks}
      readout={p.showTooltip && readout}
      anchorX={geo.xs}
      animate={p.animate}
      overlay={(active, glide) => {
        if (active != null) lastIdx.current = active;
        const i = Math.min(lastIdx.current, Math.max(p.data.length - 1, 0));
        const on = active != null ? 'true' : 'false';
        return (
          <g aria-hidden="true">
            <g className="ui-chart-active" data-active={on} data-glide={glide} style={{ transform: `translateX(${geo.xs(i)}px)` }}>
              <line className="ui-chart-crosshair" x1={0} x2={0} y1={geo.plot.top} y2={geo.plot.bottom} />
            </g>
            {geo.lines.map((l) => {
              const pt = l.points[i];
              if (!pt) return null;
              return (
                <g
                  key={l.series.key}
                  className="ui-chart-active"
                  data-active={on}
                  data-glide={glide}
                  style={{ transform: `translate(${pt.x}px, ${pt.y}px)` }}
                >
                  <circle className="ui-chart-dot" r={4.5} style={{ fill: seriesVar(l.series.index) }} />
                </g>
              );
            })}
          </g>
        );
      }}
    />
  );
}
```

### `ui/components/chart/xy-geometry.ts`

```ts
import type { AxisTick } from './chart-axes';
import { labelIndices } from './chart-axes';
import { areaPath, linePath, type Curve, type Point } from './path';
import { clamp, linearScale, niceScale, stackSeries, toNumber } from './scale';
import { labelWidth, type ResolvedSeries } from './series';
import type { ChartDatum, YAxisOptions } from './types';

export interface XYInput {
  width: number;
  height: number;
  data: ChartDatum[];
  visible: ResolvedSeries[];
  variant: 'line' | 'area';
  stacked: boolean;
  curve: Curve;
  showX: boolean;
  showY: boolean;
  yOptions: YAxisOptions;
  formatY: (v: number) => string;
  /** Axis label for each data row. */
  xLabels: string[];
}

export interface XYLine {
  series: ResolvedSeries;
  d: string;
  area: string | null;
  /** Point per data row (null where the value is missing). */
  points: (Point | null)[];
}

export interface XYGeometry {
  plot: { left: number; right: number; top: number; bottom: number };
  xs: (i: number) => number;
  indexAt: (px: number) => number;
  hTicks: AxisTick[];
  vTicks: AxisTick[];
  zeroY: number | null;
  lines: XYLine[];
}

/** Everything a line or area chart needs to draw, as pure data. */
export function computeXY(input: XYInput): XYGeometry {
  const { width, height, data, visible, variant, stacked, curve, showX, showY, yOptions, formatY, xLabels } = input;
  const n = data.length;
  const keys = visible.map((s) => s.key);
  const stack = stacked && variant === 'area' ? stackSeries(data, keys) : null;

  const stackAt = (k: number, i: number) => stack![k]![i]!;
  let min = Infinity;
  let max = -Infinity;
  visible.forEach((s, k) =>
    data.forEach((row, i) => {
      const hi = stack ? stackAt(k, i).hi : toNumber(row[s.key]);
      const lo = stack ? stackAt(k, i).lo : hi;
      if (hi == null || lo == null) return;
      max = Math.max(max, hi);
      min = Math.min(min, lo);
    }),
  );
  if (variant === 'area') {
    min = Math.min(min, 0);
    max = Math.max(max, 0);
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(min)) {
    min = 0;
    max = 1;
  }
  const [dLo, dHi] = yOptions.domain ?? ['auto', 'auto'];
  const count = yOptions.ticks ?? clamp(Math.round(height / 56), 3, 6);
  const scale = niceScale(typeof dLo === 'number' ? dLo : min, typeof dHi === 'number' ? dHi : max, count);
  const domain: [number, number] = [typeof dLo === 'number' ? dLo : scale.min, typeof dHi === 'number' ? dHi : scale.max];
  const ticks = scale.ticks.filter((t) => t >= domain[0] - 1e-9 && t <= domain[1] + 1e-9);

  const top = 10;
  const bottom = height - (showX ? 26 : 6);
  const edge = showX ? Math.ceil(labelWidth(xLabels) / 2) : 0;
  const yWidth = yOptions.width ?? labelWidth(ticks.map(formatY)) + 12;
  const left = showY ? yWidth : Math.max(6, edge);
  const right = width - Math.max(10, edge);

  const ys = linearScale(domain, [bottom, top]);
  const span = right - left;
  const xs = (i: number) => (n <= 1 ? left + span / 2 : left + (i * span) / (n - 1));
  const baseY = ys(clamp(0, domain[0], domain[1]));

  const lines: XYLine[] = visible.map((s, k) => {
    const points: (Point | null)[] = data.map((row, i) => {
      const v = stack ? stackAt(k, i).hi : toNumber(row[s.key]);
      return v == null ? null : { x: xs(i), y: ys(v) };
    });
    const defined = points.filter((p): p is Point => p !== null);
    let area: string | null = null;
    if (variant === 'area' && defined.length > 0) {
      const lower = stack ? data.map((_, i) => ({ x: xs(i), y: ys(stackAt(k, i).lo) })) : baseY;
      area = areaPath(defined, lower, curve);
    }
    return { series: s, d: linePath(points, curve), area, points };
  });

  const hTicks = ticks.map((t) => ({ pos: ys(t), label: formatY(t) }));
  const idx = showX ? labelIndices(n, span, labelWidth(xLabels)) : [];
  const vTicks = idx.map((i) => ({ pos: xs(i), label: xLabels[i] ?? '' }));

  return {
    plot: { left, right, top, bottom },
    xs,
    indexAt: (px) => (n <= 1 ? 0 : clamp(Math.round(((px - left) / span) * (n - 1)), 0, n - 1)),
    hTicks,
    vTicks,
    zeroY: domain[0] < 0 && domain[1] > 0 ? ys(0) : null,
    lines,
  };
}
```

```ts
import { useEffect, useLayoutEffect } from 'react';

/** useLayoutEffect in the browser, useEffect on the server (no SSR warning). */
export const useIsomorphicLayoutEffect = typeof window !== 'undefined' ? useLayoutEffect : useEffect;
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/chart.css`

```css
/* Chart ---------------------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-chart" style="--ui-chart-c0…">         root; series colours as CSS vars
     .ui-chart-legend > .ui-chart-legend-item (button, aria-pressed) > .ui-chart-swatch
     .ui-chart-plot                                      measured, fixed height
       .ui-chart-stage (role=group, focusable)           pointer / keyboard surface
         <svg>  .ui-chart-grid .ui-chart-axis-line .ui-chart-axis (text)
                .ui-chart-line .ui-chart-bar .ui-chart-slice .ui-chart-track .ui-chart-ring-value
                .ui-chart-active > .ui-chart-crosshair | .ui-chart-dot | .ui-chart-cursor
         .ui-chart-tooltip > -label, -row (.ui-chart-swatch, -name, -value)
         .ui-chart-center > -label, -value               donut / radial hole
     .ui-chart-sr                                        visually hidden data table / live region
   .ui-sparkline > svg
   Colours only through var(--ui-chart-cN) / semantic tokens, so theme, dark mode and
   accent switch live with no re-render.
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

@layer components {
  .ui-chart {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0.75rem;
    width: 100%;
    min-width: 0;
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  .ui-chart-plot {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
  }
  .ui-chart-stage {
    position: relative;
    outline: none;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    touch-action: pan-y;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
  }
  .ui-chart-stage:focus-visible {
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-chart-stage svg { display: block; overflow: visible; }

  /* Visually hidden (data table, live region) */
  .ui-chart-sr {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    margin: -1px;
    padding: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip-path: inset(50%);
    white-space: nowrap;
    border: 0;
  }

  /* Grid and axes */
  .ui-chart-grid {
    stroke: var(--ui-border);
    stroke-width: 1;
    stroke-dasharray: 3 4;
    opacity: 0.8;
    shape-rendering: crispEdges;
  }
  .ui-chart-axis-line {
    stroke: var(--ui-border-strong);
    stroke-width: 1;
    shape-rendering: crispEdges;
  }
  .ui-chart-axis {
    fill: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-size: 12px;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-user-select: none;
  }

  /* Marks */
  .ui-chart-line {
    fill: none;
    stroke-width: 2;
    stroke-linecap: round;
    stroke-linejoin: round;
  }
  .ui-chart-bar,
  .ui-chart-slice {
    transition: opacity var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-out), transform var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out);
  }
  .ui-chart-bar[data-dim="true"],
  .ui-chart-slice[data-dim="true"] { opacity: 0.4; }
  .ui-chart-ring { transition: opacity var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-out); }
  .ui-chart-ring[data-dim="true"] { opacity: 0.45; }
  .ui-chart-track {
    stroke: var(--ui-surface-muted);
    fill: none;
  }
  .ui-chart-ring-value { transition: stroke-width var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-out); }

  /* Crosshair, dots and bar cursor glide between indices */
  .ui-chart-active {
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-out);
  }
  .ui-chart-active[data-active="true"] { opacity: 1; }
  .ui-chart-active[data-glide="true"] {
    transition: opacity var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-out), transform 160ms var(--ui-ease-out);
  }
  .ui-chart-crosshair {
    stroke: var(--ui-border-strong);
    stroke-width: 1;
    shape-rendering: crispEdges;
  }
  .ui-chart-dot {
    stroke: var(--ui-surface);
    stroke-width: 2;
  }
  .ui-chart-cursor { fill: var(--ui-accent); opacity: 0.7; }

  /* Hole of a donut / radial */
  .ui-chart-center {
    position: absolute;
    left: 50%;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    display: grid;
    gap: 2px;
    justify-items: center;
    text-align: center;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .ui-chart-center-label {
    max-width: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    white-space: nowrap;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
  }
  .ui-chart-center-value {
    font-size: 24px;
    line-height: 1.1;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
  }

  /* Tooltip */
  .ui-chart-tooltip {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 2;
    min-width: 8.5rem;
    max-width: 16rem;
    padding: 0.5rem 0.625rem;
    display: grid;
    gap: 0.25rem;
    border: 1px solid var(--ui-border);
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--ui-surface-raised);
    color: var(--ui-surface-raised-foreground);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-md);
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 1.3;
    pointer-events: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-out);
    will-change: transform;
  }
  .ui-chart-tooltip[data-visible="true"] {
    opacity: 1;
    transition: opacity var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-out), transform 120ms var(--ui-ease-out);
  }
  .ui-chart-tooltip-label { font-weight: 500; font-size: 12px; }
  .ui-chart-tooltip-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; }
  .ui-chart-tooltip-name { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
  .ui-chart-tooltip-value {
    margin-left: auto;
    padding-left: 0.75rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .ui-chart-swatch {
    flex: none;
    width: 0.5rem;
    height: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 2px;
  }

  /* Legend */
  .ui-chart-legend {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.25rem 0.5rem;
  }
  .ui-chart-legend-item {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.375rem;
    min-height: 1.75rem;
    padding: 0 0.5rem;
    border: 0;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font: inherit;
    font-size: 12px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-out), background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-out);
  }
  .ui-chart-legend-item[aria-pressed="false"] { text-decoration: line-through; opacity: 0.6; }
  .ui-chart-legend-item[aria-pressed="false"] .ui-chart-swatch { opacity: 0.35; }
  .ui-chart-legend-item:focus-visible {
    outline: none;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent);
  }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-chart-legend-item:hover { background: var(--ui-accent); color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  }
  @media (pointer: coarse) {
    .ui-chart-legend-item { min-height: 2.25rem; }
  }

  /* Sparkline */
  .ui-sparkline { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
  .ui-sparkline svg { display: block; }
  .ui-sparkline-dot { stroke: var(--ui-surface); stroke-width: 1.5; }
}
```

## Usage

From the docs (`apps/docs/examples/chart/area-stacked.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { AreaChart } from '@/ui/components/chart';

const mrr = [
  { month: 'Jan', starter: 4200, team: 7800, enterprise: 12400 },
  { month: 'Feb', starter: 4350, team: 8100, enterprise: 13900 },
  { month: 'Mar', starter: 4600, team: 8900, enterprise: 14200 },
  { month: 'Apr', starter: 4550, team: 9600, enterprise: 16800 },
  { month: 'May', starter: 4900, team: 10300, enterprise: 18100 },
  { month: 'Jun', starter: 5100, team: 11200, enterprise: 21500 },
];

export default function AreaStacked() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full">
      <AreaChart
        data={mrr}
        index="month"
        stacked
        series={[
          { key: 'enterprise', label: 'Enterprise' },
          { key: 'team', label: 'Team' },
          { key: 'starter', label: 'Starter' },
        ]}
        valueFormat="currency"
        legend="top"
        height={288}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```
